body.zh-TW: 習慣在終端機用快捷鍵飛速跳轉程式碼的 Vim 族群，這版操作手感更貼近原生編輯器。Vim 模式新增了 `%` 移動指令，能跳到配對括號，也能搭配 `d`、`c`、`y` 執行刪除、修改或複製。以前在負載沉重的機器上按 Esc 鍵，有時會卡在 INSERT（插入模式，打字輸入內文的狀態）而無法切換。回答提問輸入框時，自由文字欄位現在支援 NORMAL（一般模式，用來執行移動與指令的瀏覽狀態）。按 Esc 只會先退回一般模式，只有在一般模式下再按 Esc 才會取消，不會直接抹掉你辛苦打好的回答。⟦跟操作傳統手排檔桿一樣，以前離合器踩下偶爾卡在空檔，現在跳檔定位精準俐落，退檔時也不會誤把轉速歸零。⟧
body.en: For Vim users accustomed to navigating code quickly with terminal shortcuts, handling now feels closer to the native editor. Vim mode introduces the `%` motion to jump between matching brackets, which also pairs with `d`, `c`, and `y` for delete, change, or yank operations. Previously, pressing Esc on heavily loaded machines could get stuck in INSERT (the state for typing text) without switching. Free-text fields in prompt inputs now support NORMAL (the navigation state for motions and commands). Pressing Esc now drops back to normal mode first, and only cancels when pressed again in normal mode, preventing your typed answer from being wiped out. ⟦Like shifting a manual transmission, depressing the clutch previously got stuck in neutral at times, but gear changes now lock in cleanly, and downshifting no longer resets engine RPM to zero by mistake.⟧

items.original:
Added the `%` motion to vim mode: jump to the matching bracket, alone or with d/c/y
Fixed vim mode sometimes staying in INSERT after Escape on a slow or busy machine
Fixed Esc discarding a typed AskUserQuestion answer in vim mode: the free-text field now supports vim NORMAL mode, and Esc cancels only from NORMAL

title.zh-TW: OpenTelemetry 追蹤指引與工具決策事件屬性擴充
title.en: OpenTelemetry Tracing Guidance and Expanded Tool Decision Event Attributes

body.zh-TW: 想在企業儀表板掌握 Claude 呼叫工具的原因，觀測日誌現在記錄得更詳盡。在 `claude-api` 技能中加入 OpenTelemetry（跨系統追蹤運作軌跡的開源標準）的設定指引，包含如何使用 `ant` 工具配置追蹤目的地。工具決策事件 `tool_decision` 新增 `classifier_verdict` 與 `permission_mode` 欄位，讓管理員分清自動模式（auto mode，讓 Claude 自主執行的模式）分類器的決策與既有權限規則。啟用 `OTEL_LOG_TOOL_DETAILS=1` 時，分類器阻擋操作的 `tool_decision` 事件還會以 `classifier_category` 記錄命中的內建規則名稱。⟦就像翻開檢驗報告，以前只標記陰陽性，現在能分清儀器判讀與人工複核，異常時還附上項目名稱。⟧
body.en: Observability logs now record more detail when tracking why Claude invokes tools in enterprise dashboards. Configuration guidance for OpenTelemetry (an open-source standard for tracking execution traces across systems) is now included in the `claude-api` skill, covering how to configure export destinations with the `ant` tool. The `tool_decision` event adds `classifier_verdict` and `permission_mode` fields, helping administrators distinguish classifier decisions in auto mode (the setting allowing Claude to execute autonomously) from existing permission rules. When `OTEL_LOG_TOOL_DETAILS=1` is enabled, `tool_decision` events where the classifier blocks an action also record the triggered built-in rule name in `classifier_category`. ⟦Picture reviewing a lab report: whereas tests previously only showed positive or negative marks, you can now separate automated instrument readings from manual reviews, complete with specific item names when abnormalities occur.⟧

items.original:
Added OpenTelemetry tracing guidance to the `claude-api` skill, including setting up trace destinations with the `ant` CLI
Added `classifier_verdict` and `permission_mode` to OpenTelemetry `tool_decision` events, so auto mode classifier decisions can be told apart from permission rules
Added `classifier_category` to OpenTelemetry `tool_decision` events, naming the built-in rule a classifier block matched, when `OTEL_LOG_TOOL_DETAILS=1`

title.zh-TW: Mod 擴充模組支援多行輸入與狀態回傳規範
title.en: Mod Extensions Add Multi-Line Input and Standardized Return States

body.zh-TW: 編寫 Mod（擴充 Claude 功能的模組）時，介面與流程控制更精準。`Input` 元件新增 `rows` 屬性，終端機能多行輸入，Enter 送出、Shift+Enter 或反斜線換行。修復在 `claude -p` 或雲端工作階段，首次回覆未完成就呼叫 `$.model.fork` 報錯 `nothing-to-fork`。提問樹狀清單在桌面端、行動端與 VS Code 支援 Markdown 且最多 48 行，終端機維持 12 行。掛鉤（hook，特定事件觸發的小程式）的 `.catch` 改為只在拋出例外或逾時時執行，內部呼叫產生的事件不再轉給自身。設定或取消設定環境變數的方法 `$.env.set`，完成操作時回傳 `{}`；未執行寫入時，回傳附帶原因的 `{ deny }`。
body.en: Interface and flow control become more precise when authoring a Mod (modules that extend Claude's capabilities). The `Input` component adds a `rows` prop for multi-line terminal input, submitting on Enter and inserting newlines on Shift+Enter or backslash. Calling `$.model.fork` before the initial response finishes in `claude -p` or cloud sessions no longer throws `nothing-to-fork`. Prompt tree lists now support Markdown with up to 48 lines across desktop, mobile, and VS Code, while staying at 12 lines in the terminal. The `.catch` handler on a hook (small programs triggered by specific events) now runs only on thrown exceptions or timeouts, and events generated by internal calls are no longer forwarded back to the hook itself. The `$.env.set` method for setting or unsetting environment variables now returns `{}` on successful operations, and `{ deny }` with a reason when writes are skipped.

items.original:
Added `rows` to a mod's `Input`: a text field of several lines in the terminal, where Enter submits and Shift+Enter or a backslash before Enter starts a new line
Fixed a mod's `$.model.fork` returning `nothing-to-fork` when called before the first response of a new Claude Code process had finished, as in `claude -p` runs and cloud sessions
Improved mods: in VS Code and the desktop and mobile apps, a tree drawn above the question dialog can now hold Markdown and up to 48 rows; the terminal keeps 12 plain rows
Changed a mod hook's `.catch` handler to run only when the hook throws or times out; events raised beneath the hook's own calls now skip that hook without asking its `.catch`
Changed a mod's `$.env.set` to resolve with `{}` once the variable is set or unset, or with `{ deny }` saying why when the write is not made

title.zh-TW: 模型切換流程與長對話自動摘要優化
title.en: Model Switching Flow and Long Conversation Auto-Summarization Improvements

body.zh-TW: 聊到一半想切換到上下文視窗較小的模型，長對話轉移現在處理得更順暢。上下文視窗是模型一次能讀取的最大文字量；若對話太長，會先請原模型精簡摘要，以前未經詢問就扣額度摘要的問題已修復。透過 Anthropic API 使用 `fable` 或 `best` 別名時，若組織尚未開放最新版 Fable，會自動退回前一版重試一次。非 Bedrock 的自訂模型名稱即便包含 `application-inference-profile`，也不會誤跑 `awsAuthRefresh` 耽擱掛鉤。透過閘道器連線時，伺服器回傳不同模型名稱，也不會再反覆用不是你選的模型壓縮對話。⟦猶如搭長途客運轉乘小型接駁車，以前未經同意就收費整理行李，現在先徵得同意，再由原班司機精簡包裹；轉運站也不會搞錯車號讓你反覆轉乘。⟧
body.en: Switching mid-conversation to a model with a smaller context window is now much smoother when transferring long dialogs. A context window represents the maximum text volume a model can read at once. When conversations run too long, the original model is asked to summarize them first, resolving an issue where quota was deducted for summarization without asking. When using `fable` or `best` aliases through the Anthropic API, organizations without access to the latest Fable release will automatically fall back to the prior version and retry once. Non-Bedrock custom model names that include `application-inference-profile` no longer mistakenly run `awsAuthRefresh` and delay hooks. When connecting through a gateway, differing model names returned by the server will no longer cause repeated conversation compression using an unselected model. ⟦A passenger transfers from a long-haul coach to a compact shuttle: luggage was previously repacked for an unapproved fee, but permission is now requested first while the original driver streamlines the cargo, and the transit station avoids mixing up fleet numbers that forced endless re-transfers.⟧

items.original:
Fixed the `fable` (and `best`) model alias erroring on the Anthropic API when the newest Fable model is not available to your organization: Claude Code now retries once on the previous Fable model
Fixed switching to a model whose name contains `application-inference-profile` running your `awsAuthRefresh` command and delaying model-switch hooks when the provider is not Bedrock
Fixed a case where switching to a model with a smaller context window could spend usage credits on a summary by the previous model without asking first
Fixed conversations being compacted over and over, on a model you didn't pick, behind an LLM gateway whose responses name a different model than the one requested
Improved switching to a model with a smaller context window: a conversation too long for the new model is now summarized by the previous model first

title.zh-TW: 技能參數填入效能與外掛權限來源顯示修復
title.en: Skill Parameter Hydration Performance and Plugin Permission Attribution Fixes

body.zh-TW: 在專案中安裝大量自訂技能或外掛工具時，指令呼叫與權限確認現在更俐落透明。過去技能（擴充特定領域知識與指令的手冊）與命令若包含過多或過長的參數名稱，呼叫時會卡頓數秒。現在限制僅填入前 64 個名稱且每個最多 64 個字元。修復了技能、命令與掛鉤在填入大量佔位符時耗用大量記憶體的問題。修復 `/rewind` 回退對話後技能清單在模型中消失的問題，並更正了 `/claude-api` 技能誤稱 AWS 上 Claude 平台不支援 CMEK 外部金鑰端點的說明。外掛或技能掛鉤若觸發 `ask` 詢問決策，彈出的權限確認提示現在會明確標示該掛鉤來自哪一個外掛或技能。⟦類似翻閱零件庫存的規格清冊，以前填寫欄位太多會整疊卡在夾板上動彈不得，現在規格索引限制在精簡欄位內，調用工具時也清楚貼上所屬工具箱的產權標籤。⟧
body.en: Invoking commands and confirming permissions is now cleaner and more transparent when projects install numerous custom skills or plugins. Previously, skills (playbooks expanding domain knowledge and commands) and commands with too many or excessively long parameter names stuttered for seconds during invocation. Hydration is now limited to the first 64 names with a maximum of 64 characters each. An issue where skills, commands, and hooks consumed excessive memory while hydrating numerous placeholders has been resolved. The skill catalog no longer vanishes from the model after running `/rewind` to roll back conversations, and documentation in `/claude-api` mistakenly claiming the Claude platform on AWS lacks CMEK external key endpoint support has been corrected. When a plugin or skill hook triggers an `ask` prompt for decisions, the confirmation dialog now clearly labels which plugin or skill originated the hook. ⟦Imagine consulting a parts inventory ledger: having too many entry fields previously jammed the entire clipboard, but specification indexes are now capped to compact entries, and retrieved tools clearly display ownership labels for their parent toolbox.⟧

items.original:
Fixed skills and commands with very many or very long argument names stalling for seconds when invoked; only the first 64 names, each up to 64 characters, are now filled in
Fixed skills, commands and hooks using very large amounts of memory when their arguments fill many placeholders
Fixed the /claude-api skill saying CMEK external-key endpoints aren't available on Claude Platform on AWS
Fixed skills no longer being listed to the model after using `/rewind`
Fixed the permission prompt for a plugin or skill hook's `ask` decision not showing which plugin or skill the hook comes from

title.zh-TW: 帳號登入與憑證更新狀態修復
title.en: Account Login and Credential Refresh Fixes

body.zh-TW: 登入更新失敗時，錯誤提示更清楚；快速執行短指令後，也不會再因更新途中結束而意外登出。過去當硬碟空間被塞滿時，系統無法完成登入憑證更新，卻彈出讓人一頭霧水的「Please run /login」錯誤訊息。現在會具體指出是哪顆磁碟空間已滿，並明確提醒你刪除檔案釋放空間。當你執行 `claude auth status` 檢查認證或 `claude plugin list` 查詢外掛等耗時短暫的指令時，過去若指令在 token（驗證身分的授權令牌）更新途中結束，會引發更新逾時甚至意外登出。這種登入更新逾時與意外登出的問題已經修好。⟦正如到銀行櫃檯辦理印鑑更新，以前印泥乾掉卻謊稱印章作廢，快閃刷本子還會把帳戶直接凍結；現在印泥不夠會直接請你更換，查詢一下餘額也不再被誤踢出門。⟧
body.en: Error messages are clearer when login refresh fails, and running quick commands will no longer cause accidental logouts if they terminate mid-refresh. Previously, when disk space filled up completely, the system failed to refresh login credentials and instead displayed a confusing "Please run /login" error message. It now identifies the exact disk that is out of space and explicitly prompts you to remove files to free up room. When running quick commands like `claude auth status` or `claude plugin list`, if the command exited while refreshing a token (an authorization ticket used to verify identity), it previously triggered refresh timeouts and unexpected logouts. These login refresh timeouts and accidental sign-outs are now fixed. ⟦Consider updating a signature seal at a bank counter: dried ink previously led to false claims that your seal was invalid, and quick passbook checks froze accounts on the spot, but low ink now prompts an immediate refill request and quick balance inquiries no longer get you kicked out.⟧

items.original:
Fixed a misleading "Please run /login" error when a full disk keeps the login from being refreshed; the error now names the disk and says to delete files
Fixed sign-in refresh timeouts and unexpected sign-outs after a short command such as `claude auth status` or `claude plugin list` exited in the middle of a token refresh

title.zh-TW: 成品發布更新機制與行動版版面繪製修正
title.en: Artifact Publishing Updates and Mobile Layout Rendering Fixes

body.zh-TW: 請 Claude 產出獨立網頁或文件成品（artifacts）時，更新內容與手機預覽現在都更穩定。在設定了攔截編輯或寫入的 PreToolUse 掛鉤環境下，過去更新成品時常會被直接拒絕。現在 Claude 會先正常編輯檔案再重新發布，而不是試圖在發布呼叫中直接修改檔案。在行動端應用程式中，Claude 產出的網頁以前捲動時文字會穿透到置頂標題上方。現在上方色帶會確實著色覆蓋，捲動內容不再穿幫破圖。⟦彷彿為展覽海報加裝固定展示框，以前更換內容非得當場塗改版面而遭警衛攔阻，現在先取下內頁修潤再重新入框，走動時頂部邊框也能確實遮擋後方紙張。⟧
body.en: Updating content and previewing on phones is now more reliable when asking Claude to produce standalone web pages or document artifacts. In environments configured with PreToolUse hooks that intercept edits or writes, updating artifacts previously met with outright rejection. Claude now edits the file normally before republishing, instead of attempting to modify files directly inside the publishing call. In the mobile app, text on Claude-generated web pages previously bled above the sticky header during scrolling. The top header band now renders solid background fill, preventing scrolled content from showing through. ⟦A display case protects an exhibition poster: updating the print previously involved defacing the surface on-site and drawing security guards, but staff now remove the sheet to touch it up before reframing, and the top frame solidly covers the page beneath as people walk past.⟧

items.original:
Fixed artifact updates being refused where a PreToolUse hook covers Edit or Write; Claude now edits the file and then republishes instead of changing it in the publish call
Improved artifacts: pages Claude writes now paint the band above a sticky header, so scrolled text no longer shows there in the mobile apps

title.zh-TW: 檔案讀取、搜尋工具與 Git 操作修復
title.en: File Reading, Search Tools, and Git Operation Fixes

body.zh-TW: 盤點專案原始碼或比對版本差異時，底層檢查工具的回報比以往更誠實安全。Grep 與 Glob 等搜尋工具過去在搜尋程式意外崩潰時，會回傳查無結果；現在會老實拋出錯誤告知搜尋失敗。Read 讀取工具不再將 `.xlsm`、`.parquet`、`.epub` 與 `.heic` 等二進位檔案誤當成純文字讀入。使用 `WorktreeCreate` 掛鉤建立的 Git 工作樹（worktree，讓同一專案平行開多份副本的功能），若裡面還有尚未推送的提交，退出 Claude Code 時不會再不問一聲就悄悄刪除。在採用 reftable 格式的 Git 存放庫中，若底層檢查逾時或失敗，`/diff` 指令不再漏掉發生衝突的揀選或復原操作。⟦如同替檔案室裝上嚴格的清點規範，儀器當機不再謊報查無資料，翻閱圖冊不再當成純文字硬讀，搬移未歸檔的文件箱離場時也必定當面確認。⟧
body.en: Underlying inspection tools report results more faithfully and safely when auditing source code or comparing version diffs. When search processes crashed unexpectedly, search tools like Grep and Glob previously returned empty results. They now properly throw errors to report the search failure. The Read tool no longer mistakenly ingests binary files such as `.xlsm`, `.parquet`, `.epub`, and `.heic` as plain text. When exiting Claude Code, Git worktrees (capabilities allowing parallel copies of the same project) created via `WorktreeCreate` hooks are no longer silently deleted if unpushed commits remain. In Git repositories using the reftable format, the `/diff` command no longer misses conflicted cherry-pick or revert operations if underlying inspections time out or fail. ⟦Just as strict auditing protocols govern an archive room, equipment crashes no longer falsely report missing records, illustrated volumes are not forced into plain text transcripts, and unfiled document crates require in-person sign-off before leaving the floor.⟧

items.original:
Fixed quitting removing a worktree made by a `WorktreeCreate` hook without asking when it may hold unpushed commits
Fixed Grep and Glob reporting no matches when the search program failed unexpectedly before returning any results; they now return an error saying the search failed
Fixed the Read tool reading binary files such as .xlsm, .parquet, .epub and .heic as text
Fixed `/diff` not noticing a conflicted cherry-pick or revert in reftable repositories when one of its git checks timed out or failed

title.zh-TW: 工作流程自動化與背景指令執行修復
title.en: Workflow Automation and Background Command Execution Fixes

body.zh-TW: 安排多代理人或腳本排程自動處理專案時，背景步驟與權限控管更為穩定。工作流程代理人過去讀到任務說明未附帶使用者授權的框架備註後，有時會擅自略過自己的步驟卻仍回報執行成功，這個問題已經修復。在同一個工作階段中執行 Bash `cd` 切換目錄後，讀取、編輯或重跑工作流程腳本不再莫名彈出權限確認或直接被拒絕。工具呼叫若在權限檢查期間被回合中途傳入的訊息中斷，現在不會再向模型誤報為使用者拒絕。在 Windows 環境下，被終止的背景 PowerShell 命令輸出檔過去會漏掉結尾的 `[killed]` 標記，現在均已正常補上。⟦恰似工廠的自動化輸送帶，以前看到便箋誤以為沒有權限就偷跳步驟還回報良品，切換站別就拒絕作業；現在每個工序確實執行，中途停機也確實蓋上停止印戳。⟧
body.en: Background steps and permission controls are significantly more dependable when orchestrating multi-agent or scripted project automations. When workflow agents encountered framework notes indicating missing user authorization in task descriptions, they previously skipped steps while falsely reporting success, an issue that is now fixed. After running Bash `cd` to change directories within the same session, reading, editing, or re-running workflow scripts no longer prompts unexpected permission requests or fails with rejections. Tool calls interrupted by incoming mid-turn messages during permission evaluation are no longer falsely reported to the model as user rejections. On Windows, output files from terminated background PowerShell commands that previously missed the trailing `[killed]` indicator now append it properly. ⟦Much like an automated factory conveyor belt, notes once led stations to skip assembly steps while marking items passed and station handoffs triggered outright refusal, but every procedure now executes faithfully while mid-process halts receive clear cancellation stamps.⟧

items.original:
Fixed workflow agents sometimes skipping their step, and the run still reporting success, after reading the harness note that their task text carries no user authority
Fixed a tool call cut off by a message sent mid-turn during its permission check being reported to the model as rejected by the user
Fixed workflow scripts asking for permission or being refused when read, edited or re-run after a Bash `cd` in the same session
Windows: Fixed stopped background PowerShell commands missing the closing `[killed]` line in their output file

title.zh-TW: 終端機文字雜訊、表格排版與暗色色彩修正
title.en: Fixes for Terminal Text Artifacts, Table Layout, and Dark Theme Colors

body.zh-TW: 開啟終端機執行指令時，螢幕畫面上的字元邊界與色彩層次變得更加乾淨易讀。在 RHEL 8 的 MATE 終端機等使用舊版 VTE（終端機模擬器核心元件，版本低於 0.53）的環境中，修復了 `>0q` 遮擋資料夾信任提示以及退出時出現 `>4m` 雜訊的問題。修復特定版本 iTerm2 啟動時提示字元前方出現殘留 `GOK` 字樣的問題。只有標題列的 Markdown 表格若寬度超出終端機，過去會完全無法顯示（包含出現在計畫核准卡片中的表格），現在均能正常繪製。在暗色 ANSI 主題與 16 色終端機下，填滿方框內的文字維持淡化，但在選取與搜尋醒目提示下不再淡化，清單說明文字也正確比照次要文字淡化處理。⟦就像老舊顯示螢幕完成校正，以前開機常跳出訊號雜訊、寬表格直接破圖消失，現在所有字樣清楚對齊，在暗色背景下也層次分明。⟧
body.en: When opening a terminal to run commands, character boundaries and color gradations on screen are now cleaner and easier to read. In environments such as MATE Terminal on RHEL 8 that use older versions of VTE (terminal emulator core component, versions below 0.53), fixes resolve `>0q` obscuring folder trust prompts and `>4m` noise appearing upon exit. A bug where leftover `GOK` text appeared in front of the prompt upon launching certain iTerm2 versions has been fixed. Markdown tables containing only a header row previously failed to render completely when their width exceeded the terminal (including tables appearing in plan approval cards), but they now draw properly. Under dark ANSI themes and 16-color terminals, text inside filled boxes remains dimmed, but it is no longer dimmed under selections and search highlights, and list descriptions are also correctly dimmed like secondary text. ⟦Old computer displays finally receive proper calibration: boot-up static previously scrambled text and wide tables disappeared broken, but every character now aligns neatly with sharp contrast against dark backgrounds.⟧

items.original:
Fixed stray characters such as `>0q` covering the folder trust prompt, and `>4m` before the shell prompt at exit, in terminals built on VTE older than 0.53 such as MATE Terminal on RHEL 8
Fixed stray `GOK` text appearing in the prompt at startup in some versions of iTerm2
Fixed a Markdown table with only a header row drawing nothing when too wide for the terminal, including in plans on the plan approval card
Fixed dim text on the dark ANSI theme and 16-color terminals: faint inside filled boxes, not faint under selection and search highlights, and list descriptions dimmed like other secondary text

title.zh-TW: 工作階段對話壓縮、提示與子代理進度更新優化
title.en: Optimizations for Session Compaction, Prompts, and Subagent Progress Updates

body.zh-TW: 進行長時間對話或派發子任務時，畫面不再因資料繁重而短暫凍結。在全螢幕模式下執行 `/compact` 或自動壓縮時，過去因重建可見對話紀錄會造成介面短暫卡頓，現在已修復。在長時間運作的子代理人（subagent，負責獨立執行特定子任務的代理人）工作時，進度歷程改為增量更新，不再每次渲染都整條重算。重新接續先前的工作階段時，壓縮提示列不再提供無法載入歷史紀錄的 Ctrl+O 捷徑，而是清楚說明先前訊息儲存在哪個路徑，且此提示在全螢幕下也能正常顯示。當你中途打斷回覆時，過去會立刻冒出建議輸入 `/clear` 清除對話省 token（AI 處理與計費的文字單位）的提示，現在不會再立刻跳出來干擾。⟦比方翻閱長篇連載小說，以前每翻一頁就重新把前幾章裝訂一次導致卡死，現在只順暢翻到最新一頁，換卷時也清楚標記上一冊收在何處。⟧
body.en: When engaging in lengthy conversations or dispatching subtasks, the interface no longer freezes briefly from heavy data loads. A brief UI stutter caused by rebuilding visible message history when running `/compact` or automatic compaction in fullscreen mode has now been fixed. During long-running subagent (an agent that independently performs a specific subtask) tasks, progress history now updates incrementally instead of recalculating the entire trail on every render. When resuming a previous session, the compaction prompt bar no longer offers a Ctrl+O shortcut that fails to load history, but instead clearly explains the path where earlier messages are stored, and this prompt now displays properly in fullscreen mode as well. When you interrupt a response midway, a prompt that previously appeared immediately suggesting `/clear` to clear conversations and save tokens no longer pops up right away to cause disruption. Tokens are units of text used for AI processing and billing. ⟦Reading a serialized novel is much smoother now: rather than rebinding all earlier chapters with every page turn and causing a jam, the reader simply turns to the newest page, with each new volume clearly noting where the previous book is archived.⟧

items.original:
Fixed the compaction row in a resumed session offering ctrl+o for history that is not loaded; it now says where the earlier messages are saved, and also shows in fullscreen
Fixed the "new task? /clear to save tokens" hint coming back right after you interrupt a response
Fullscreen mode: Fixed `/compact` and auto-compact briefly freezing the UI while the visible transcript is rebuilt
Improved rendering performance while a long-running subagent works: its progress trail now updates incrementally instead of being reprocessed in full on every render

title.zh-TW: 自架執行器工作階段重試與存放庫連結修復
title.en: Fixes for Self-Hosted Runner Session Retries and Repository Attachment

body.zh-TW: 串接團隊通訊軟體並使用自託管 Runner 時，工作階段的啟動與釋放更值得信賴。修復從 Slack 啟動的工作階段在受管設定限制 MCP（Model Context Protocol，讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）伺服器時，無法找到或掛載存放庫的問題。若需停用特定工具，可在設定中配置 `deniedMcpServers`。修復無關的環境設定或工作階段失敗訊息引用 Git 遺失參照字眼時，工作階段被誤判為來源分支已刪除、因而不再重試的問題。即將結束的工作階段若在釋放資源時失敗或遭拒，日誌不再承諾重試；重複失敗時會顯示失敗次數。⟦形同無人調度車隊的基地閘門，以前防護限制一開就找不到車位，報修時引用特定代碼就被誤判為整輛車報廢，現在入庫停妥順暢，收工異常時也會確實記錄次數。⟧
body.en: When integrating team chat apps and using self-hosted runners, session launch and teardown become significantly more reliable. A fix resolves an issue where sessions launched from Slack failed to find or mount repositories when managed settings restricted MCP (Model Context Protocol, a protocol that connects AI to external tools) servers. If specific tools must be disabled, `deniedMcpServers` can be configured in settings. A bug has been fixed where unrelated environment settings or session failure messages citing missing Git reference wording caused sessions to be misidentified as having a deleted source branch, preventing retries. If a terminating session fails or is rejected while releasing resources, logs no longer promise retries. Repeated failures now display the failure count. ⟦Automated fleet depots operate with dependable entry gates: security limits previously blocked vehicles from locating parking bays and repair tickets citing specific codes mistakenly marked entire cars as scrapped, but now parking proceeds smoothly and abnormal check-ins record exact failure counts.⟧

items.original:
Self-hosted runner: Fixed sessions started from Slack being unable to find or attach a repository when managed settings restrict MCP servers; use `deniedMcpServers` to keep those tools off
Self-hosted runner: Fixed sessions being reported as having a deleted source branch, and not retried, when an unrelated setup or session failure quoted git's missing-ref wording
Self-hosted runner: Fixed the log promising a retry of a failed or declined session release for a session that is ending; repeated failures now show a count

title.zh-TW: VS Code 擴充功能支援數學公式渲染與面板效能修復
title.en: VS Code Extension Support for Mathematical Formulas and Panel Performance Fixes

body.zh-TW: 在 VS Code 面板與 Claude 討論題目時，公式呈現更漂亮且對話操作更滑順。Claude 的回覆支援 LaTeX 數學公式，包含獨立段落的 `$$`、多行 `\[ … \]` 與行內 `$…$`、`\(…\)` 語法。VS Code 與 JetBrains 面板中，Pro 與 Max 方案的用量上限橫幅新增「Get more usage」連結。修復對話造成面板當機或凍結後，每次重新載入視窗又強制重開該對話的惡性循環。修復長時間思考時面板變慢的問題，不再每次更新都重新解析整段思考文字。部分語言伺服器回報問題時不再顯示 `[object Object]`，而是正確顯示規則代號（例如 MD013）。非 claude.ai 登入或遠端視窗等未提供聽寫的環境，不再載入原生音訊模組檢查麥克風權限。⟦就像把黑板搬進編輯器，方程式排版工整漂亮，推導再久也不會卡死在惡性循環裡。⟧
body.en: Formulas render more cleanly and conversation interactions feel smoother when discussing problems with Claude in the VS Code panel. Claude's responses now support LaTeX mathematical formulas, including standalone paragraph `$$`, multiline `\[ … \]`, and inline `$…$` or `\(…\)` syntax. In VS Code and JetBrains panels, a "Get more usage" link has been added to the usage limit banner for Pro and Max plans. A fix resolves a vicious cycle where a conversation that crashed or froze the panel was forcefully reopened every time the window reloaded. Panel slowdowns during extended thinking have been resolved by no longer reparsing the entire thinking text on every update. When certain language servers report issues, they no longer display `[object Object]`, correctly showing rule identifiers instead (such as MD013). Environments without dictation, such as non-claude.ai logins or remote windows, no longer load the native audio module to check microphone permissions. ⟦Classroom blackboards move straight into the editor: equations stay neatly typeset, and no derivation freezes the workspace in a vicious cycle no matter how long it takes.⟧

items.original:
[VSCode] Added LaTeX math rendering in Claude's responses, including `$$` and multi-line `\[ … \]` blocks and inline `$…$` and `\(…\)` math
[VSCode] Added a "Get more usage" link to the usage-limit banner for Pro and Max plans in the VS Code and JetBrains panels
[VSCode] Fixed a conversation that crashes or freezes the panel being reopened on every reload
[VSCode] Fixed the chat panel slowing down during long thinking: it no longer re-parses the whole thinking text on every update
[VSCode] Fixed diagnostics showing "[object Object]" instead of the rule code (e.g. MD013) for some language servers
[VSCode] Fixed the native dictation audio module being loaded, to check microphone permission, where dictation is not offered (non-claude.ai sign-ins, remote windows)

title.zh-TW: /config 支援跨類別搜尋設定，即時修改並提示重啟
title.en: /config Supports Cross-Category Setting Search, Instant Edits, and Restart Prompts

body.zh-TW: 當你想調整 Codex 的各項參數，卻記不清具體設定名稱藏在哪個分類時，現在直接輸入 `/config` 就能解決。⟦彷彿走進大型量販店使用智慧導覽機，以前要一層層貨架慢慢找商品，現在直接搜尋關鍵字就能立刻取貨，機器還會貼心提醒哪些生鮮結帳後必須馬上冷藏。⟧輸入 `/config` 後，你可以跨越不同分類快速搜尋偏好設定，支援的選項能當場修改；哪些變更需要重啟，介面也會清楚標示，不必再自己猜測設定是否需要重啟。
body.en: When you want to adjust parameters in Codex but cannot recall which category a specific setting is tucked under, typing `/config` now solves the problem immediately. ⟦Picture using a smart kiosk in a large wholesale store: previously you had to browse through aisle after aisle of shelves to find an item, but now searching by keyword lets you pick it up immediately, and the machine even helpfully reminds you which perishables must be refrigerated right after checkout.⟧ After entering `/config`, you can quickly search for preferences across different categories, and supported options can be modified on the spot. The interface also clearly indicates which changes require a restart, sparing you from guessing whether a setting demands one.

items.original: Open `/config` to search preferences across categories, change supported settings immediately, and see which changes require a restart. (#52990, #53429)

title.zh-TW: 生成中途可即時追問轉向，中斷時同步停止程式碼與工具呼叫
title.en: Steer Generations Mid-Stream with Follow-Up Prompts, Halting Code and Tool Calls on Interrupt

body.zh-TW: 看著 AI 劈頭往錯誤的方向洋洋灑灑寫下去，你不用再乾等它講完廢話才能打字糾正。⟦好比教練在場邊即時對球員大喊變更戰術，以前只能眼睜睜看著整套戰術打完才能檢討，現在哨音一響場上球員立刻改變跑位，正在熱身準備上場的替補球員也會全部停下動作。⟧Codex 正在回答的當下，你可以隨時送出後續追問來即時引導思考方向。如果你決定中斷這次回應，正在執行的 Code Mode（逐格執行程式碼的模式）儲存格會立刻停止，連同其巢狀工具呼叫也一併結束，避免背景程序白白空轉。
body.en: Watching the AI dash off in the wrong direction with paragraph after paragraph, you no longer have to wait idly until it finishes before typing a correction. ⟦Think of a coach shouting tactical changes from the sidelines to players in real time: previously you had to watch the entire play run its course before reviewing it, but now players shift positions the moment the whistle blows, while bench substitutes warming up to enter the game halt their movements as well.⟧ While Codex is in the middle of responding, you can send follow-up prompts at any time to steer its train of thought on the fly. If you decide to interrupt the response, currently executing Code Mode (a mode that executes code cell by cell) cells stop immediately, and their nested tool calls are terminated alongside them, preventing background processes from spinning in vain.

items.original: Send a follow-up while Codex is responding to steer it immediately. Interrupting a turn also stops active Code Mode cells and their nested tool calls. (#51812, #51835)

title.zh-TW: /keymap 支援自訂前導鍵，快捷鍵提示常駐且語音靜音改為 F9
title.en: /keymap Supports Custom Leader Keys, Sticky Shortcut Prompts, and Moves Voice Mute to F9

body.zh-TW: 習慣用鍵盤快速叫出各種操作的讀者，現在調整自訂按鍵更加得心應手。⟦如同樂團指揮設定了預備拍，以前比劃動作稍縱即逝容易漏看，現在提示手勢會穩穩停在空中等你接招，也把靜音操作換到另一個指定琴鍵。⟧在 `/keymap` 設定中，你可以自由配置前導鍵（按下一組按鍵後等待後續指令的引導鍵），系統預設組合為 `Ctrl+X`。按下後跳出的快捷鍵提示會持續停留在畫面上，直到你做出選擇或取消為止。語音靜音功能則移到了 `F9` 按鍵。
body.en: Readers accustomed to invoking operations swiftly via the keyboard can now customize key bindings with far greater ease. ⟦Imagine an orchestra conductor establishing a preparatory beat: previously the fleeting gesture was easily missed, but now the cueing hand rests steadily in the air waiting for your response, while the mute control is reassigned to another designated piano key.⟧ Within `/keymap` settings, you can freely configure a leader key (a guiding key that waits for follow-up inputs once pressed), with the system defaulting to `Ctrl+X`. The shortcut prompt that appears after pressing it remains on screen until you make a choice or cancel. Voice muting has been moved to the `F9` key.

items.original: Configure a leader key in `/keymap`. The default is `Ctrl+X`, shortcut hints stay open until you choose or cancel, and voice mute moves to `F9`. (#52273)

title.zh-TW: /daemon 支援重啟背景伺服器，中斷前主動警告並自動重連
title.en: /daemon Supports Restarting Background Servers with Disruption Warnings and Auto-Reconnect

body.zh-TW: 當背景執行的伺服器連線卡住或需要重載時，你不必再大費周章手動終止處理程序。⟦就像大樓總電源維護前廣播通知，以前電閘一拉整棟直接斷電，現在管理員會先警告哪些電梯與設備即將暫停，重啟完畢後還會自動幫大家把照明重新接通。⟧現在從 `/daemon` 指令就能直接重啟受管的背景伺服器（常駐在系統底層默默運作的背景程序）。重啟前，Codex 會先跳出警告，提醒這次重啟可能會中斷哪些進行中的工作。確認執行後，系統會在伺服器重啟完成時自動重新連線，省去手動重連的繁瑣步驟。
body.en: When a background server connection hangs or requires a reload, you no longer need to go through the hassle of manually killing the process. ⟦Consider a building announcement prior to main electrical maintenance: previously throwing the main switch cut power to the entire building without ceremony, but now the superintendent first warns which elevators and facilities will temporarily halt, and automatically reconnects lighting once the restart completes.⟧ You can now restart managed background servers (daemons running quietly at the system level) directly from the `/daemon` command. Before restarting, Codex displays a warning outlining which active tasks might be disrupted. Once confirmed, the system automatically reconnects as soon as the server finishes rebooting, eliminating tedious manual reconnection steps.

items.original: Restart a managed background server from `/daemon`. Codex warns about work the restart could interrupt, then reconnects automatically. (#53173)

title.zh-TW: 唯讀工具支援平行執行，技能、記憶與對話紀錄查詢不再排隊
title.en: Read-Only Tools Support Parallel Execution: Skills, Memory, and Session History Queries No Longer Queue Up

body.zh-TW: 提問時需要 AI 同時調閱多項過往資訊的讀者，現在能感受到明顯更快的查詢反應。⟦跟圖書館調派多位館員同時分頭找書一樣，以前一個人要先找完歷史檔案才能去翻閱典藏技能，現在三位館員各自朝不同書架出發，找齊資料後一口氣交到你手上。⟧Codex 現在能夠平行（同時多工處理而不依序等待）執行彼此互不干擾的獨立唯讀工具。這項機制涵蓋了擴充技能檢索、記憶調閱，以及對話歷史紀錄查詢。這些互不衝突的讀取工作現在能同步展開，縮短等待回答的時間。
body.en: Readers whose questions require the AI to retrieve multiple pieces of past information at once will now notice noticeably faster query responses. ⟦A library dispatches multiple librarians to fetch books simultaneously: where one person previously had to search historical archives before checking archived skills, three librarians now head toward separate shelves at once and deliver everything into your hands the moment it is gathered.⟧ Codex can now execute mutually independent read-only tools in parallel (processing tasks concurrently without waiting in line). This mechanism covers skill retrieval, memory lookups, and session history queries. These non-conflicting read tasks now run concurrently, cutting down the wait time for answers.

items.original: Codex can run independent read-only tools in parallel, including skill, memory, and conversation-history lookups. (#52245)

title.zh-TW: Daybreak 模型對合格帳號預設啟用，codex exec 支援金鑰指定選用
title.en: Daybreak Model Enabled by Default for Eligible Accounts, with Key-Based Selection in codex exec

body.zh-TW: 想體驗最新 Daybreak 模型的讀者，只要帳號符合資格，打開程式就能直接用上。⟦宛若高鐵會員自動升級商務車廂，以前必須特地到櫃檯出示證件申請，現在符合條件的旅客刷票進站就能直接入座，在自動售票機輸入個人憑證也能順利劃位。⟧針對符合資格的帳號，Codex 現已預設啟用 Daybreak 模型。如果你習慣使用終端機指令 `codex exec` 執行任務，在伺服器提供存取權限的前提下，只要附上 OpenAI API 金鑰（存取雲端服務的通關密鑰），也能透過該指令自由選用 Daybreak 模型。
body.en: Readers eager to experience the latest Daybreak model can now use it right out of the box, provided their account is eligible. ⟦A high-speed rail membership automatically upgrades passengers to business class: where travelers once had to present identification at the counter to apply, eligible passengers can now swipe their tickets at the gate to take their seats directly, while entering personal credentials at automated ticketing machines also secures a seat smoothly.⟧ Codex now enables the Daybreak model by default for eligible accounts. If you prefer running tasks with the terminal command `codex exec`, you can also freely select the Daybreak model through that command by supplying an OpenAI API key (the secret pass for accessing cloud services), provided the server grants access.

items.original: Daybreak is enabled by default for eligible accounts. `codex exec` can also select it with an OpenAI API key when the server offers access. (#53701, #53717)

title.zh-TW: 對話串切換支援 /side 回到分支，重啟時完整恢復授權與網路許可
title.en: Thread Switching Supports /side to Return to Branches, Fully Restoring Authorizations and Network Permissions on Reopen

body.zh-TW: 頻繁在多個任務之間切換對話串（在同一專案中分頭進行的獨立對話紀錄）的讀者，現在不用擔心進度與設定跑位。⟦有如在辦公室借調多份專案公文，以前換個案子審核印章就得重新蓋過，現在換回舊案能直接調閱已批准的用印紀錄，派出去的公文回函也會精準送回當初發文的專案夾。⟧切換對話串後，你可以隨時輸入 `/side` 指令回到先前的旁支對話。如果切換前有尚未回覆完畢的提示詞，產生的答案也會準確送回當初提問的對話串。當你重新打開已保存的對話串時，先前擁有的權限與網路存取許可都會完整還原，同時依然遵守手動覆寫與現行的管理政策。
body.en: Readers who frequently switch between threads (independent conversation logs running concurrently in the same project) no longer need to worry about losing progress or configuration state. ⟦Handling multiple project dossiers in an office setting once required restamping approvals whenever you switched cases, but returning to an earlier case now pulls up previously approved seal records directly, and replies to dispatched memos return precisely to the originating project folder.⟧ After switching threads, you can type the `/side` command at any point to return to a previous side discussion. If a prompt was still generating when you switched, the resulting response is routed accurately back to the thread where the question originated. When reopening a saved thread, your previously granted authorizations and network access permissions are fully restored, while continuing to respect manual overrides and active administrative policies.

items.original:
Resuming a saved thread restores its permissions and network approvals, while respecting explicit overrides and current managed policy. (#53150, #53419, #53424)
Return to an existing side conversation with `/side` after switching threads. Answers to pending prompts also go back to the thread that asked. (#52184, #53436)

title.zh-TW: 網路代理加強防護：DNS 查詢前先審核、阻擋重複標頭與憑證別名繞過
title.en: Network Proxy Security Tightens: Pre-DNS Query Audits, Blocking Duplicate Headers and Credential Alias Bypasses

body.zh-TW: 在需要透過代理伺服器連接外部網路的環境中，這項更新替連線安全築起了更嚴格的防線。⟦猶如機場海關加強查驗流程，以前旅客報出目的地前不會先核驗護照，現在查驗官在查詢航線前就先確認出境許可，嚴查重複填寫的申報表，也不再讓換了別名的違禁證件繞過檢查站。⟧網路代理現在會在發起網域名稱查詢（將網址轉譯為伺服器位址的查詢）前，先行檢查該連線是否具備相應權限。代理伺服器也會主動拒絕帶有重複 `Host` 標頭的請求，並防止憑證別名繞過檢查掛鉤（特定事件發生時被觸發的小程式），杜絕未經授權的潛在連線漏洞。
body.en: In environments that route external network traffic through a proxy server, this update erects a stricter line of defense for connection security. ⟦Customs inspectors at an airport checkpoint tighten screening procedures: where officers previously did not verify passports before travelers stated their destinations, inspectors now confirm exit permits before looking up flight routes, strictly scrutinize duplicate declaration forms, and block contraband credentials disguised under aliases from slipping past checkpoints.⟧ The network proxy now verifies whether a connection holds appropriate permissions before initiating a domain name query (resolving a web address into a server destination). The proxy server also actively rejects requests bearing duplicate `Host` headers and prevents credential aliases from bypassing check hooks (small routines triggered when specific events occur), plugging potential unauthorized connection loopholes.

items.original: The network proxy now checks permission before a DNS lookup, rejects duplicate `Host` headers, and prevents credential aliases from bypassing inspection hooks. (#51650, #52661, #53506)

title.zh-TW: Windows 支援快捷鍵貼圖，WSL 剪貼簿重複讀取並防止複製卡死
title.en: Windows Gains Image Pasting Shortcuts, While WSL Reuses Clipboard Readers and Prevents Copy Freezes

body.zh-TW: 在 Windows 或 WSL（Windows 系統內建的 Linux 子系統）環境下操作終端機的讀者，剪貼內容時將順暢許多。⟦恰似換了一組靈敏的櫃檯讀卡機，兩組指定快捷鍵都能把文字與圖片直接貼進視窗；頻繁讀取時能共用讀取模組，複製操作也會逾時退出，不再一直卡住。⟧在 Windows 中，`Ctrl+V` 與 `Shift+Insert` 現在都能貼上文字與圖片。而在 WSL 環境下，連續多次貼上會重複使用剪貼簿讀取器；複製操作在遇到阻礙時則會逾時退出，不再無休止地卡死畫面。
body.en: Readers running terminals under Windows or WSL (Windows Subsystem for Linux) will experience far smoother clipboard workflows. ⟦Upgrading to a responsive card reader at a checkout counter allows two designated shortcuts to feed both text and images straight into the window, frequent scans share the reader module, and stalled copy operations time out instead of hanging indefinitely.⟧ On Windows, both `Ctrl+V` and `Shift+Insert` can now paste text and images. Under WSL, successive pastes reuse the clipboard reader, while copy operations encountering obstacles time out gracefully rather than freezing the screen indefinitely.

items.original: On Windows, `Ctrl+V` and `Shift+Insert` paste text as well as images. On WSL, repeated pastes reuse the clipboard reader, and copy attempts time out instead of hanging. (#53224, #52967, #53453)

title.zh-TW: 指令輸出修復：本地與遠端傳輸更穩，codex exec 不再重複印出差異
title.en: Command Output Fixes: Steadier Local and Remote Transfers, codex exec Stops Reprinting Diffs

body.zh-TW: 經常在終端機執行本機指令或遠端遙控工作的讀者，這次更新修復了多項令指令卡住或資訊混亂的輸出問題。⟦宛如貨運物流中心整頓了出貨流程，以前只要下游包裝箱還沒封口，送貨司機就算卸完貨也只能在原地枯等，現在確認卸貨完成就能迅速出發，晚到的包裹也能妥善入庫而不被遺漏。⟧以前執行本機指令時，只要底層的子行程（由主程式衍生出來獨立處理任務的分支程式）沒有關閉輸出管道，整個指令就會乾等而不肯結束。現在本地指令在工作完成後能迅速結束。執行遠端指令時，晚到的輸出內容現在會妥善保留，確保最後一次輪詢時依然能完整收集。使用 `codex exec` 執行無關指令後，終端機也不會再重複印出先前的檔案差異清單。
body.en: For readers who regularly run local commands or remote tasks in the terminal, this update resolves several output glitches that previously hung commands or cluttered information. ⟦A freight logistics hub overhauls its shipping workflow: previously, as long as downstream packing crates remained unsealed, delivery drivers had to wait idly on site even after finishing unloading, but now drivers depart promptly once unloading is confirmed, and late-arriving parcels are safely warehoused rather than missed.⟧ Previously when running local commands, as long as underlying subprocesses (child processes spawned by the main program to handle tasks independently) kept output pipes open, the overall command would stall indefinitely rather than terminate. Local commands now exit promptly once their work is done. When executing remote commands, late-arriving output is now safely retained, ensuring it is fully collected during the final poll. Running unrelated commands via `codex exec` also no longer causes the terminal to reprint previous file diffs.

items.original:
Local commands finish promptly when a child keeps an output pipe open. Remote commands preserve late-arriving output so the final poll can still collect it. (#52652, #53331, #53622)
`codex exec` no longer prints the same file diff again after an unrelated command. (#53444)

title.zh-TW: 隨附技術文件更新：收錄 GPT-6 遷移指引與 Linux 沙箱架構說明
title.en: Bundled Documentation Update: GPT-6 Migration Guide and Linux Sandbox Architecture Details

body.zh-TW: 正在規劃將專案升級至新世代模型，或關注系統底層安全防護的讀者，現在能從隨附文件中查閱更詳盡的官方指南。⟦正如工廠設備手冊換上新版擴建指南，不僅詳細列出升級新型機具時的運轉特性與資料所在地考量，也公開了安全防護罩如何隔絕危險區域並過濾高壓氣流。⟧隨附的 OpenAI 文件已更新針對 GPT-6 系列模型的遷移指引，詳細說明了各模型特定的推理特性、外部工具使用方式，以及資料駐留（資料儲存與處理的地理位置）相關考量。隨附說明也進一步釐清了 Linux 沙箱機制的運作方式，詳細介紹系統如何透過 bubblewrap 達成檔案系統隔離，並藉由 seccomp 進行系統呼叫過濾。
body.en: Readers planning to upgrade projects to next-generation models or keeping an eye on low-level system security can now consult more detailed official guidance in the bundled documentation. ⟦A factory equipment manual swaps in a fresh expansion guide, not only detailing the operational characteristics and data location considerations when upgrading to new machinery, but also revealing how safety shields isolate hazardous areas and filter high-pressure airflow.⟧ The bundled OpenAI documentation updates migration guidance for the GPT-6 model family, detailing model-specific reasoning characteristics, external tool usage, and data residency (the geographic location where data is stored and processed) considerations. The bundled documentation also clarifies how the Linux sandbox mechanism operates, detailing how the system achieves filesystem isolation through bubblewrap and filters system calls via seccomp.

items.original:
Updated the bundled OpenAI Docs guidance for migrations to the GPT-6 family, including model-specific reasoning, tool use, and data residency considerations. (#51768)
Clarified how the Linux sandbox uses bubblewrap for filesystem isolation and seccomp for syscall filtering. (#52610)

title.zh-TW: 安裝包體積縮減，改用 Codex 的標準 shell 執行器並提示設定遷移
title.en: Package Size Reduced with Codex's Standard Shell Runner and Config Migration Notice

body.zh-TW: 在 Linux 與 macOS 環境下安裝或更新 Codex 的讀者，這次會發現下載更輕盈且底層執行器更單純。⟦與出差輕裝上陣的概念相同，以前行李箱裡硬塞了一整套自備工具組，現在改用原有的標準工具，並把非必要的裝飾吊牌全數卸下，讓行李箱體積與重量減輕不少。⟧官方透過從安裝二進位檔中剝除符號（除錯用的內部名稱標籤），縮減了 Linux 與 macOS 版本的安裝套件體積，原始建置產物則依然保留完整符號。在執行架構上，Codex 現在改用 Codex 的標準 shell 執行器（負責執行命令的工具），不再隨附修補版的 `zsh`。如果既有設定仍包含已淘汰的 shell 標記，系統會跳出遷移通知協助你平順過渡。
body.en: Readers installing or updating Codex on Linux and macOS will find lighter downloads and a simpler underlying runner. ⟦A business traveler packs light under the same principle: rather than stuffing a custom toolkit into a suitcase, they rely on existing standard tools and strip away nonessential decorative tags, significantly reducing suitcase size and weight.⟧ The team reduced package sizes for Linux and macOS releases by stripping symbols (internal name labels used for debugging) from installation binaries, while raw build artifacts still retain full symbols. In terms of execution architecture, Codex now switches to Codex's standard shell runner (a tool responsible for executing commands), no longer bundling a patched `zsh`. If existing configurations still contain deprecated shell flags, the system displays a migration notice to help you transition smoothly.

items.original:
Codex now uses its standard shell executor and no longer bundles a patched `zsh`. Configurations using the retired shell flags receive a migration notice. (#52160, #52213)
Reduced Linux and macOS release package size by stripping symbols from packaged binaries while preserving them in the original build outputs. (#52178)

title.zh-TW: 終端機顯示多行提問不再當機
title.en: Terminal Displaying Multiline Prompts No Longer Crashes

body.zh-TW: 當你在文字視窗等待背景任務，途中跳出落落長的確認提問時，畫面不會再突然卡死關閉。以前遇到非同步提問（程式在背後運作時插進來詢問意見的對話）包含多行文字，終端機文字介面常會直接當機。這個問題現在已經修好，訊息裡的換行排版會原樣保留，附帶的超連結完整網址也不會遺失。以前常因為介面當機而看不到完整問題，現在長內容與跳轉連結都能順利讀取。
body.en: When you wait for background tasks in a text window and a lengthy confirmation prompt pops up along the way, the screen will no longer suddenly freeze and close. Previously, when asynchronous prompts (dialogues that interrupt to ask for input while programs run in the background) contained multiline text, the terminal text interface often crashed directly. This issue is now fixed, with line breaks in messages preserved as formatted and full URLs in attached hyperlinks no longer lost. While users previously often missed full questions due to interface crashes, long content and redirect links can now be read smoothly.

items.original: Fixed a TUI crash when asynchronous questions contain multiple lines, preserving line breaks and complete hyperlink destinations. (#51866)

title.zh-TW: 命令列啟動不再因背景伺服器設定不同而失敗
title.en: Command-Line Startup No Longer Fails Over Differing Background Server Settings

body.zh-TW: 如果你習慣讓工具在背後持續運作，開新視窗輸入指令時，不必再擔心程式卡在開頭進不去。以前只要正在執行的背景伺服器與命令列介面（CLI，用文字指令操作的工具）預設設定不同，啟動就會報錯失敗。現在相容性檢查只會在命令列明確覆寫功能時才進行，啟動失敗的問題已經修好。以前常因預設值不同而被擋在門外，現在就算背景設定有別也能順利開啟。
body.en: If you are used to letting tools run continuously in the background, you no longer need to worry about programs getting stuck at startup when entering commands in a new window. Previously, whenever the running background server and the command-line interface (tools operated with text commands) had different default settings, startup would fail with an error. Now, compatibility checks only run when the command line explicitly overrides features, and the startup failure issue has been fixed. While users were previously locked out due to differing default values, the tool can now launch smoothly even when background configurations differ.

items.original: Fixed startup failures caused by differences between a running background server's feature settings and CLI defaults. Compatibility checks now apply only to explicit command-line feature overrides. (#52648)

title.zh-TW: 支援管理 Git 工作樹，平行開發多分支
title.en: Support for Managing Git Worktrees to Develop Multiple Branches in Parallel

body.zh-TW: 當你想在同一個專案同時開發不同功能，又不想頻繁切換分支打斷進度時，現在可以在受信任的本機專案中使用專屬工具。只要開啟工作樹功能，AI 就能直接建立並列出託管的 Git 工作樹（worktree，讓同一專案平行開多份副本的功能）。⟦好比在圖畫紙旁多鋪一張描圖紙，以前想畫草稿必須擦掉原本的線條，現在能同時畫兩張草圖而且隨時對照。⟧
body.en: When you want to develop different features in the same project simultaneously without interrupting progress by frequently switching branches, dedicated tools are now available in trusted local projects. Once the worktree feature is enabled, the AI can directly create and list managed Git worktrees (parallel copies of the same project managed by Git). ⟦Picture laying an extra sheet of tracing paper beside your drawing paper: whereas sketching a new idea previously meant erasing original lines, you can now work on two drafts simultaneously and cross-reference them at any time.⟧

items.original: Add tools for creating and listing managed Git worktrees from trusted local projects when the worktrees feature is enabled. (#50148)

title.zh-TW: 按鍵釘選重要任務，集中在置頂群組
title.en: Pin Important Tasks via Keystroke to Group Them at the Top

body.zh-TW: 當你在代理人的命令中心同時追蹤好幾個任務，想把當前最重要的項目固定在顯眼處時，現在只要按下鍵盤上的 p 鍵就能快速釘選。只要伺服器支援這項功能，被釘選的任務就會統一歸入共用的 Pinned 群組中，方便你隨時回頭檢視這些項目的處理進度。⟦像在辦公白板上貼便利貼，以前待辦項目一多很容易被新任務洗下去，現在能把要緊的事釘在最上方的專用區域，一眼就能看清。⟧
body.en: When tracking multiple tasks simultaneously in the agent command center and looking to keep the most critical items prominent, you can now press the p key on your keyboard to pin them quickly. As long as the server supports this capability, pinned tasks are consolidated into a shared Pinned group, making it easy to review their progress at any time. ⟦Like placing sticky notes on an office whiteboard, where a growing list of to-dos once got buried under incoming tasks, you can now pin pressing items to a dedicated top section for immediate visibility.⟧

items.original: Pin tasks in the agent Command Center with `p` and keep them in a shared Pinned group when supported by the server. (#51500)

title.zh-TW: 終端介面複製更靈活，滾輪速度隨意調
title.en: Flexible Terminal UI Copying and Adjustable Scroll Speed

body.zh-TW: 在終端介面翻看長篇對話時，如果你想快速抓出某段程式碼或重點回覆，現在的操作方式更加順手。你可以直接輸入 /copy 來選取並複製對話紀錄區塊，或是按下 Ctrl+Insert 複製目前滑鼠反白的文字。如果覺得終端介面捲動太快或太慢，還可以在設定中加入 tui.mouse_scroll_speed 調整滑鼠滾輪的捲動速度。⟦彷彿看長篇電子書時換了順手的翻頁器，以前選字複製經常受限於視窗操作，現在能精準抓取段落還能微調捲動步調。⟧
body.en: When browsing long conversations in the terminal UI, extracting specific code snippets or key responses is now much smoother. You can enter /copy to select and copy conversation blocks, or press Ctrl+Insert to copy text currently highlighted by the mouse. If the terminal UI scrolls too fast or too slow, you can also add tui.mouse_scroll_speed in the settings to adjust the mouse wheel scroll speed. ⟦Think of switching to a handy page-turner while reading a long e-book, where selecting and copying text was once constrained by window interactions, but you can now capture exact passages and fine-tune your scrolling pace.⟧

items.original: Navigate and copy transcript blocks with `/copy`, use `Ctrl+Insert` to copy selections, and tune mouse-wheel scrolling with `tui.mouse_scroll_speed`. (#50434, #50215, #50209)

title.zh-TW: 終端各類提示網址皆可點，跨行連結不中斷
title.en: Clickable Terminal Prompt URLs with Unbroken Multi-Line Links

body.zh-TW: 當 AI 在終端機跳出確認提問或警告訊息並附上參考網址時，你現在不必再手動反白複製。不論網址出現在確認標頭、提問清單、警告橫幅、驗證提示，還是 MCP（Model Context Protocol，讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）提示中，都能直接點擊開啟。就算網址太長被終端機自動折到下一行，連結依然能完整點開而不會斷成兩截。⟦好似在紙本書的註腳旁附上完整 QR 碼，以前長網址印成兩行容易抄錯，現在直接掃描就能連到正確網頁。⟧
body.en: When the AI displays confirmation questions or warning messages in the terminal with reference URLs, you no longer need to manually highlight and copy them. Whether a URL appears in a confirmation header, question list, warning banner, verification prompt, or an MCP (Model Context Protocol, a protocol that connects AI to external tools) prompt, you can click to open it directly. Even if a URL is long and wrapped to the next line by the terminal, the link still opens completely without breaking in two. ⟦A printed book includes a complete QR code next to its footnotes: whereas long URLs split across two lines were once prone to copying errors, scanning directly now opens the exact page.⟧

items.original: Make URLs clickable in approval headers, questions, MCP prompts, warnings, banners, and verification prompts, including when links wrap across lines. (#51439, #51449, #51450, #51451, #51452, #51458)

title.zh-TW: 自訂模型支援聯網搜尋，可開啟遠端壓縮
title.en: Custom Models Gain Web Access and Remote Compaction Support

body.zh-TW: 如果你串接了相容於 Responses 介面的自訂模型供應商，現在能替它們啟用更多進階能力。你可以直接為這些自訂模型設定即時聯網功能（live web access），讓模型取得最新網路資訊。還可設定遠端壓縮能力（remote compaction），讓對話內容的濃縮由遠端處理。⟦如同替外聘的專家助理配置即時百科與秘書，你可以替他配上查詢新資料的工具，也可以安排秘書協助濃縮紀錄。⟧
body.en: If you connect custom model providers compatible with the Responses API, you can now enable more advanced capabilities for them. You can configure live web access directly for these custom models so they can retrieve the latest web information. You can also configure remote compaction so that conversation summaries are processed remotely. ⟦Equipping an external expert assistant with an updated encyclopedia and a secretary allows you to provide tools for looking up fresh data while also assigning a secretary to condense conversation logs.⟧

items.original: Configure live web access and remote compaction capabilities for custom Responses-compatible model providers. (#50459)

title.zh-TW: JavaScript 支援非同步串流，程式模式工具可排序
title.en: JavaScript Async Streaming Support and Ranked Tools in Code Mode

body.zh-TW: 在撰寫自動化腳本或使用程式模式（Code Mode）處理大量工具時，開發體驗得到了進一步強化。這次新增了 JavaScript 輔助工具，能在多個非同步操作（Promise）各自完成時立即串流回傳結果，不必苦等全部做完才一次收到。此外在 Code Mode 中，你還可以主動啟用排序工具搜尋功能，讓系統依照關聯度推薦最合適的工具。⟦跟外送點餐即時收到每道菜出餐通知一樣，以前得等整桌菜炒完才送上來，現在哪道先好就能先拿到並更快找到餐具。⟧
body.en: When writing automation scripts or handling numerous tools in Code Mode, the development experience is further enhanced. New JavaScript helper utilities now stream results back immediately as multiple asynchronous operations (Promise instances) complete individually, without waiting for every task to finish. Furthermore, in Code Mode, you can actively enable ranked tool search so the system recommends the most relevant tools by relevance. ⟦Food delivery orders send real-time alerts as each dish leaves the kitchen: instead of waiting for the entire table of dishes to be cooked before serving, you receive each item as it is ready and locate utensils much faster.⟧

items.original: Add JavaScript helpers for streaming promise results as they settle, plus opt-in ranked tool search in Code Mode. (#51126, #51209)

title.zh-TW: 終端對話遵循預設模型，保留手動指定參數
title.en: Terminal Sessions Follow Default Models While Preserving Manual Overrides

body.zh-TW: 當你開啟新的終端對話時，系統現在會優先採用伺服器端設定的模型與推理摘要預設值。以前新建對話可能忽略伺服器給定的預設配置，現在系統會完整遵循這些預設選項。假使你在啟動時手動傳入了特定參數，系統也會優先保留你明確指定的覆寫值，不會被預設設定強行蓋過。⟦宛若走進連鎖餐廳用餐，以前廚房常搞錯標準配方，現在預設會照標準菜單出餐，但也依然遵循你點單時註明的客製需求。⟧
body.en: When starting a new terminal conversation, the system now prioritizes server-configured defaults for models and reasoning summaries. Whereas creating a new conversation previously could ignore default server settings, the system now adheres fully to these defaults. If you manually pass specific parameters at launch, the system also prioritizes and retains your explicit override values instead of overwriting them with defaults. ⟦Dining at a chain restaurant illustrates the change: while the kitchen previously could mix up standard recipes, it now serves according to the standard menu by default while still honoring any custom preferences specified on your order.⟧

items.original: Respect server model and reasoning-summary defaults for new TUI threads while retaining explicit launch overrides. (#50013, #50811, #50913)

title.zh-TW: 套用補丁保留換行格式，Windows 檔案不跑版
title.en: Patch Application Preserves Line Endings Without Corrupting Windows Files

body.zh-TW: 在 Windows 環境下修補程式碼時，你不再需要特地手動指定設定來維持原本的換行格式。以前執行 apply_patch 更新檔案時，若未額外開啟選項，既有的 CRLF（Windows 標準換行符號）可能會被改掉；現在 apply_patch 會自動保留檔案原有的換行格式。這個問題已經修好，能避免檔案送出版控時多出整份換行差異。⟦跟維護舊文件一樣，以前每次送出修訂都得額外勾選保留原本排版，否則換行符號會被洗掉；現在直接套用也能原樣留存。⟧
body.en: When patching code in Windows environments, you no longer need to manually specify settings to preserve original line endings. Previously, updating files with apply_patch could alter existing CRLF line endings (the standard Windows line-ending format) unless an extra option was enabled; apply_patch now automatically preserves the file's original line endings. This issue is resolved, preventing unintended diffs across the entire file when committing changes to version control. ⟦Maintaining legacy documents once required ticking an extra box on every revision to keep original formatting from getting overwritten, but applying edits now preserves line endings automatically.⟧

items.original: Preserve existing CRLF line endings in `apply_patch` updates without requiring an opt-in. (#51203)

title.zh-TW: Linux 沙箱啟動防護強化，嚴格落實檔案隔離
title.en: Enhanced Linux Sandbox Startup Protections and Enforced File Isolation

body.zh-TW: 在 Linux 環境中使用安全沙箱隔離執行環境時，系統修復了多項攸關啟動與檔案存取的安全限制。當設定了多個禁止存取的檔案時，沙箱以前可能無法順利啟動，現在啟動流程已修復。沙箱現在會拒絕可被寫入的建構執行檔。也修正了 ripgrep 設定，確保搜尋配置不會削弱禁止規則（deny-glob）的檔案遮罩防護。⟦就像保險庫修好了門禁名單一多就卡住的問題，也拒用能被改動的門禁安裝工具，並讓查找物品的設定不會削弱禁止存取的名單。⟧
body.en: When using the security sandbox to isolate execution environments on Linux, the system fixed several security constraints related to startup and file access. The sandbox previously could fail to start when multiple denied files were configured, but this startup process is now fixed. Sandboxes now reject writable executables used to construct the sandbox. The ripgrep configuration was also corrected to ensure search settings do not weaken deny-glob file mask protections. ⟦A bank vault fixes a stall that occurred whenever access denial lists grew too long, rejects modifiable installation tools, and ensures search settings never undermine restricted lists.⟧

items.original: Fix Linux sandbox startup with multiple denied files, reject writable sandbox-construction executables, and keep ripgrep configuration from weakening deny-glob masks. (#50059, #51211, #51407, #51527)

title.zh-TW: Windows 10 磁碟存取恢復，沙箱暫存權限一致
title.en: Restored Windows 10 Drive Access and Consistent Sandbox Temp Permissions

body.zh-TW: 如果你在 Windows 10 系統上執行指令或使用沙箱隔離環境，先前遇到的路徑找不到與權限錯誤已獲得修復。現在恢復了一般磁碟代號（如常見的 C 槽與 D 槽）檔案存取能力，讀寫既有檔案不再出錯。Windows 沙箱內的暫存目錄權限也調整為與子行程（subprocess，由主程式啟動的附屬運作程序）環境一致，避免程式在執行時因權限不符而卡住。⟦有如拿到了相符的門禁卡，以前在 Windows 10 容易讀不到磁碟或被暫存目錄擋在門外，現在權限一致後各項操作都能順利通行。⟧
body.en: If you run commands or use sandboxed environments on Windows 10, previously encountered missing path and permission errors are now resolved. Standard drive letter file access (such as common C: and D: drives) is restored, preventing errors when reading or writing existing files. Permissions for temporary directories inside the Windows sandbox are also aligned with environments of subprocesses (child processes started by the main program), preventing programs from hanging due to permission mismatches during execution. ⟦Obtaining a matching keycard resolves previous hurdles on Windows 10 where drives were unreadable or temp directories locked you out, ensuring all operations proceed smoothly with consistent permissions.⟧

items.original: Restore ordinary drive-letter file access on Windows 10 and match Windows sandbox temp permissions to the child process environment. (#51511, #51512)

title.zh-TW: 遵循伺服器建議時間重試
title.en: Retrying Requests Following Server Recommendations

body.zh-TW: 使用 Codex 時，送出的請求或即時連線若失敗，你可能需要等一段時間才能重試。Responses（傳送模型請求的介面）的可重試失敗，現在會遵循伺服器的 Retry-After 建議。這個標頭會告訴用戶端應等待多久再試。WebSocket（維持雙向即時通訊的連線）的可重試失敗也適用：依照建議時間等待後再重試。⟦好比撥打客服電話遇到忙線，聽到語音建議稍後再撥，就依照建議等候，再重新撥打。⟧
body.en: When using Codex, if a sent request or real-time connection fails, you may need to wait for a while before retrying. Retryable failures for Responses (the interface for sending model requests) now follow the server's Retry-After recommendation. This header tells the client how long to wait before trying again. Retryable failures for WebSocket connections (which maintain two-way, real-time communication) also follow this rule by waiting for the suggested duration before retrying. ⟦When dialing a busy customer service line, a caller follows the automated voice prompt to wait for the suggested time before calling back.⟧

items.original: Honor server `Retry-After` advice for retryable Responses and WebSocket failures. (#50418, #51440)

title.zh-TW: Windows 安裝程式附帶數位簽章，版本下載更安全
title.en: Windows Installers Include Digital Signatures for Safer Version Downloads

body.zh-TW: 在 Windows 下安裝或更新系統時，安裝腳本與版本下載機制現在具備更高的安全性與相容性。Windows 發行版本現在附帶已簽署的 PowerShell 安裝程式。當環境中存在 PowerShell 7 模組路徑時，舊版透過 Windows PowerShell 安裝可能發生的壓縮檔校驗碼驗證失敗問題也已修好。下載管理方面，系統現在能防止舊版或預覽版本意外覆蓋較新的穩定版下載目標與安裝別名。⟦猶如官方包裹附上可核對來源的簽名，以前可能誤把舊包裹拿來替換新品，現在不會了。⟧
body.en: When installing or updating the system on Windows, installer scripts and version download mechanisms now offer higher security and compatibility. Windows releases now include a signed PowerShell installer. When PowerShell 7 module paths exist in the environment, archive checksum verification failures that previously occurred when installing through Windows PowerShell are now fixed. For download management, the system now prevents older or preview versions from accidentally overwriting newer stable download targets and installation aliases. ⟦Receiving an official package with a verifiable signature ensures that old parcels are no longer mistakenly used to replace brand-new items.⟧

items.original:
Fix archive checksum verification when installing through Windows PowerShell with PowerShell 7 module paths present. (#51257)
Publish a signed PowerShell installer with Windows releases. (#51158)
Keep older stable releases and prereleases from replacing newer stable download targets or installer aliases. (#51186, #51425)

title.zh-TW: /diff 與產物檢視器新增搜尋功能，支援跨檔案逐筆跳轉
title.en: /diff and Artifact Viewer Add Search with Cross-File Match Navigation

body.zh-TW: 比對大批修改內容時，要在冗長的變更清單中精準定位某個函式或變數往往相當費時。在 `/diff` 的檔案清單與檔案檢視中，按下 `/` 即可啟動搜尋。輸入關鍵字時會即時反白相符字串，提示列還會列出整份差異比對與各檔案分別包含多少筆相符項目。按下 `Enter` 會跳到第一筆結果，接著按 `n` 或 `N` 就能跨檔案逐筆來回巡覽，頁首也會顯示如 `match A/B` 的進度指示。⟦尋訪長篇族譜名冊時，以前只能逐頁掃描而容易看漏同行的重複名字；現在輸入字根便立刻標記全冊，提示列載明各章節出現次數，還能依序巡禮每個相符人名。⟧在產物檢視器（artifact viewer，用來預覽生成文件的面板）中按 `n` 與 `N`，現在也會逐筆跳過同一行內的多個項目，不再整行跳躍。
body.en: When reviewing large sets of changes, pinpointing a specific function or variable across a lengthy change list is often time-consuming. In the file list and file view of `/diff`, pressing `/` starts a search. Typing keywords highlights matching strings in real time, while the prompt bar lists total matches across the diff and per file. Pressing `Enter` jumps to the first result, and pressing `n` or `N` navigates back and forth between matches across files, with the header showing progress indicators like `match A/B`. ⟦When searching through a lengthy genealogy registry, people previously had to scan page by page and easily missed duplicate names on the same line; now, typing a root immediately highlights the entire registry, with a prompt bar showing the number of occurrences per chapter, and lets you browse each matching name in sequence.⟧ In the artifact viewer (a panel used to preview generated documents), pressing `n` and `N` now also steps through multiple matches on the same line rather than skipping entire lines.

items.original: Added `/` search to the `/diff` file list and file view: matches are highlighted as you type, the search prompt shows how many matches the diff and each file contain, `Enter` jumps to the first match, and `n`/`N` step through matches one at a time across every file, with `match A/B` in the file view header. `n`/`N` in the artifact viewer now also step through matches one at a time, including several on the same line, instead of jumping from line to line.

title.zh-TW: 外掛驗證新增結構檢查，修正 Windows 覆寫防護與顏色輸出
title.en: Plugin Validation Adds Structural Checks, Fixing Windows Overwrite Protection and Color Output

body.zh-TW:
外掛設定疏漏或檔案被佔用以往容易導致異常。`agy plugin validate` 新增結構檢查：無法解析 `hooks.json`、`sidecar.json` 或元件清單時報錯；遇未知掛鉤、無效正規表達式（用符號比對字串）、未讀取的 `hooks/hooks.json`、遺漏路徑、不載入的 `commands/` 與 `workflows/` 或頂層 `"hooks"` 鍵名則警告。

在 Windows 更新或重裝外掛時，若被其他工作階段佔用，以前會留下半刪除毀損目錄；新版就位前舊版維持完整，替換失敗也會還原。

`agy plugin install` 與 `agy plugin import` 修正了導向輸出夾帶色碼的問題，現在只在終端機著色，並遵循 `NO_COLOR`、`CLICOLOR` 與 `CLICOLOR_FORCE`。
body.en:
Oversights in plugin configuration or occupied files previously caused errors. `agy plugin validate` adds structural checks, reporting errors if `hooks.json`, `sidecar.json`, or component manifests cannot be parsed. It warns on unknown hooks, unread `hooks/hooks.json`, missing paths, unloaded `commands/` and `workflows/`, or top-level `"hooks"` keys. It also warns on invalid regular expressions (patterns used to match strings).

When updating or reinstalling plugins on Windows, if files were locked by another session, a half-deleted corrupted directory was previously left behind. The old version now remains intact until the new version is in place, and rolls back if replacement fails.

`agy plugin install` and `agy plugin import` fix an issue where redirected output included color escape codes. Output is now colored only in the terminal, respecting `NO_COLOR`, `CLICOLOR`, and `CLICOLOR_FORCE`.

items.original:
Improved `agy plugin validate` to also check a plugin's hooks, sidecars, and component lists: it reports an error when `hooks.json`, a `sidecar.json`, or a `skills.json`, `rules.json`, `agents.json`, or `sidecars.json` file can't be parsed, and warns about unknown hook events, hook matchers that aren't valid regular expressions and so never match, a `hooks/hooks.json` file (which isn't read), list entries with no path or with a path missing from the plugin, `commands/` folders and `workflows/` Markdown files (which plugins don't load), and a Claude Code-style top-level `"hooks"` key, which loads as a single hook named `hooks`.
Fixed updating or reinstalling a marketplace plugin on Windows leaving it half-deleted when another `agy` session, the Antigravity desktop app, or the Remote Control background service had it open; the installed plugin now stays intact until the new copy is in place, and the previous version is restored if the replacement fails.
Fixed `agy plugin install` and `agy plugin import` writing color codes into piped or redirected output, ignoring `NO_COLOR`, and showing raw codes in older Windows consoles; like `agy plugin validate`, they now use color only in a terminal and follow `NO_COLOR`, `CLICOLOR`, and `CLICOLOR_FORCE`.

title.zh-TW: /tasks 計時器改以天時分秒顯示，清楚掌握剩餘時間
title.en: /tasks Timers Switch to Days, Hours, Minutes, and Seconds for Clearer Remaining Time

body.zh-TW: 當你在背景啟動了長時間排程，隨時掌握任務的等待時間是安排後續工作的關鍵。在終端機查看進行中的排程計時器時，時間標示方式直接影響你掌握進度的速度。在 `/tasks` 任務清單與作用中任務清單中，計時器標籤現在改以天、小時、分鐘與秒數來顯示時間長度，例如呈現為 `1d 2h timer` 或 `5m timer`。以前這裡只會顯示原始秒數，像是 `93784s timer`，讓人難以一眼看出到底還要等多久。⟦盯著大樓停車場的繳費機螢幕，以前停留時間只顯示幾萬秒讓人摸不著頭緒；現在直接換算成幾天幾小時幾分幾秒，一眼就能看清車輛停放了多久。⟧當你設定了排程任務時，只要在對話中輸入 `/tasks`，就能立刻從清單看到以天或分鐘標示的計時器，不必再自行拿計算機換算秒數。
body.en: When running long-running schedules in the background, keeping track of task waiting time is key to planning subsequent work. When checking active scheduled timers in the terminal, the time display format directly affects how quickly you grasp progress. In the `/tasks` task list and active tasks list, timer labels now display durations in days, hours, minutes, and seconds, appearing as `1d 2h timer` or `5m timer`. Previously, this displayed only raw seconds like `93784s timer`, making it hard to tell at a glance how much waiting time remained. ⟦Picture the screen of a parking payment machine, where parking duration previously showed only tens of thousands of seconds and left drivers baffled; now it directly converts into days, hours, minutes, and seconds, making it obvious at a glance how long a vehicle has been parked.⟧ When you configure scheduled tasks, simply typing `/tasks` in a conversation lets you immediately see timers labeled in days or minutes from the list, without needing a calculator to convert seconds yourself.

items.original: Improved timer labels in `/tasks` and the active task list to show durations in days, hours, minutes, and seconds, such as `1d 2h timer` or `5m timer`, instead of raw seconds such as `93784s timer`.

title.zh-TW: 修復以金鑰連線時未顯示 Gemini 4 Argon 的問題
title.en: Fix Missing Gemini 4 Argon When Connecting with an API Key

body.zh-TW: 習慣使用個人 API 金鑰切換模型時，可用清單若漏列特定選項會影響工作調度。當你透過環境變數 `GEMINI_API_KEY`（Gemini 服務的存取金鑰）連線時，先前在切換模型的 `/model` 指令選單以及 `--model` 啟動參數中，都沒有列出 Gemini 4 Argon 模型。現在這個問題已經修好，以金鑰連線時也能正常在選單與參數中指定該模型。
body.en: When you are accustomed to switching models using a personal API key, missing options from the available list disrupt workflow planning. When connecting through the `GEMINI_API_KEY` environment variable (the access key for Gemini services), the Gemini 4 Argon model was previously omitted from the `/model` command selection menu and the `--model` launch flag. This issue is now resolved, and you can properly select the model from the menu and specify it via the flag when connecting with an API key.

items.original: Fixed Gemini 4 Argon not shown in `/model` and `--model` when you connect with a `GEMINI_API_KEY`.

title.zh-TW: 不支援沙盒的作業系統不再列出終端機沙盒選項
title.en: Terminal Sandbox Options Omitted on Operating Systems Lacking Sandbox Support

body.zh-TW: 在不支援終端機沙盒（隔離執行指令的受限環境）的電腦上打開 CLI，本來就用不了的選項不該出現在選單裡。這類系統包括阻擋非特權使用者命名空間的 Linux 系統，以及 Windows 11 24H2 之前的舊版 Windows，以前命令列介面仍會提供需要沙盒支援的選項。這個問題已經修好，不支援沙盒的系統上不會再看到需要沙盒的選項。
body.en: When opening the CLI on a machine that does not support a terminal sandbox (a restricted environment that isolates command execution), unusable options should not appear in the menu. Such systems include Linux systems blocking unprivileged user namespaces and versions of Windows prior to Windows 11 24H2, where the command-line interface previously still offered options requiring sandbox support. This issue has been resolved, and systems without sandbox support will no longer display options requiring a sandbox.

items.original: Fixed the CLI offering options that need the terminal sandbox on systems where it can't run, such as Linux systems that block unprivileged user namespaces and Windows before Windows 11 24H2.

title.zh-TW: 自動模式子代理指令改由獨立代理審核，安全操作免手動核准
title.en: Auto-Mode Subagent Commands Reviewed by Independent Agent, Allowing Safe Operations Without Manual Approval

body.zh-TW: 讓代理在背景自動排解複雜任務時，頻繁跳出確認提示會打斷原本流暢的工作流程。在自動模式下，子代理（subagent，負責分流特定任務的輔助代理）與自訂代理以往只要執行脫離終端機沙盒的指令，每次都會停下來要求你手動核准。現在比照主代理的處理機制，它們的指令會先由另一個獨立代理負責審核。安全指令會直接執行，只有具備潛在風險的操作才會跳出提示向你確認。
body.en: When letting agents automatically handle complex tasks in the background, frequent confirmation prompts interrupt an otherwise smooth workflow. In auto mode, subagents (auxiliary agents that handle specific tasks) and custom agents previously paused to require manual approval every time they executed a command outside the terminal sandbox. Matching the behavior of the main agent, their commands are now reviewed first by an independent agent. Safe commands run directly, and only potentially risky operations prompt you for confirmation.

items.original: Fixed subagents and custom agents in Auto mode asking you to approve every command that would leave the terminal sandbox; like the main agent's, their commands are now first reviewed by a separate agent, so safe commands run without asking and risky ones still prompt you.

title.zh-TW: 對話壓縮保留子代理編號，精簡摘要不再丟失背景任務
title.en: Conversation Compaction Preserves Subagent IDs, Preventing Compacted Summaries from Losing Background Tasks

body.zh-TW: 長時間對話進行壓縮整理時，歷史任務資訊若被截斷，會讓代理遺忘先前派出的幫手。以前對話摘要會塞入每個子代理完整的初始提示詞，往往因為長度超限而在記錄對話編號（conversation ID）前就被截斷，導致代理失去對近期子代理的追蹤。現在壓縮摘要只保留各子代理的類型、角色與執行結果，確保識別資訊完整留存，並為語境視窗（context window，模型一次能讀取的記憶上限）留出更多空間。
body.en: When compacting and summarizing long conversations, truncated historical task information causes the agent to forget previously delegated helpers. Previously, conversation summaries included the full initial prompts for each subagent, which frequently exceeded length limits and were truncated before recording conversation IDs, causing the agent to lose track of recent subagents. Compacted summaries now retain only the type, role, and execution results of each subagent, ensuring identifiers are preserved while freeing up space for the context window (the maximum memory a model can read at one time).

items.original: Fixed the agent losing track of its most recently started subagents after a conversation was compacted, because the summary included each subagent's full initial prompt and was cut off before their conversation IDs; the summary now keeps only each subagent's type, role, and result, which also leaves more room in the context window.

title.zh-TW: PostToolUse 掛鉤失敗改為記錄日誌，不再將工具誤判為失敗
title.en: PostToolUse Hook Failures Now Logged Rather Than Misreporting Tool Failures

body.zh-TW: 設定工具執行的後續連動時，附加檢查腳本若發生異常，不應影響主要操作的成敗判定。在工具呼叫後觸發的 `PostToolUse` 掛鉤（特定事件發生時被觸發的小程式）若執行失敗，例如指令不存在、執行逾時、退出回傳錯誤或輸出無效的 JSON，以前會將原本成功的工具呼叫直接標記為失敗。現在這類失敗只會記錄在日誌中，工具會完整保留原本的執行成果。
body.en: When configuring post-execution actions for tools, errors in supplemental check scripts should not affect the outcome of the primary operation. If `PostToolUse` hooks (small programs triggered when specific events occur) failed after a tool call—such as from a missing command, execution timeout, non-zero exit code, or invalid JSON output—the system previously marked an otherwise successful tool call as failed. Such failures are now recorded only in logs, leaving the original tool results fully intact.

items.original: Fixed a `PostToolUse` hook that fails to run, for example because its command is missing, exits with an error, times out, or prints invalid JSON, marking the tool call it follows as failed even though the tool succeeded; the failure is now logged and the tool keeps its result.

title.zh-TW: 修復空白檔案建立失敗，以及專案寫入誤報產物路徑的問題
title.en: Fix Empty File Creation Failures and Erroneous Artifact Path Errors on Project Writes

body.zh-TW: 讓代理建立新模組或初始化目錄時，建立標記檔案與修改專案內容是常見的操作。以前代理在建立如 `__init__.py` 或 `.gitkeep` 等空白檔案時會執行失敗，而且當模型送出空白的產物資訊時，寫入或編輯一般專案檔案也會跳出 `... is not a valid artifact path` 的報錯。現在這個問題已經修好，建立零內容檔案與正常編輯專案檔案都能順利完成。
body.en: When having an agent create new modules or initialize directories, generating marker files and modifying project contents are common operations. Previously, agents failed when creating empty files such as `__init__.py` or `.gitkeep`. In addition, writing or editing normal project files threw a `... is not a valid artifact path` error whenever the model sent blank artifact information. This issue is now resolved, allowing both zero-content file creation and standard project file editing to complete smoothly.

items.original: Fixed the agent failing to create empty files such as `__init__.py` or `.gitkeep`, and failing to write or edit regular project files with `... is not a valid artifact path` when the model sent blank artifact details.

title.zh-TW: iPhone 與 iPad 遠端控制支援狀態記憶，不再重複提示條款與通知
title.en: Remote Control on iPhone and iPad Adds State Persistence, Ending Repeated Terms and Notification Prompts

body.zh-TW: 在行動裝置上透過遠端功能查看進度時，每次開啟都必須手動關閉重複的提示視窗相當不便。在 iPhone 與 iPad 上使用 Remote Control（遠端控制功能）時，以前每次重新開啟，都會重複要求同意 `Security Notice & Data Use` 安全與資料使用條款，並再次彈出 `Enable Notifications` 啟用通知提示。現在應用程式會記住你的回覆，連同主題、排版設定以及已關閉的提示一併儲存。
body.en: When monitoring progress remotely on mobile devices, having to manually dismiss repetitive modal dialogs upon every launch is frustrating. When using Remote Control on iPhone and iPad, reopening previously prompted users to accept the `Security Notice & Data Use` terms again and popped up the `Enable Notifications` prompt each time. The application now remembers your responses, saving them alongside your theme, layout preferences, and dismissed prompts.

items.original: Fixed Remote Control on iPhone and iPad asking you to accept the `Security Notice & Data Use` terms and showing the `Enable Notifications` prompt again every time you reopened it; it now remembers your answers, along with your theme, layout, and dismissed tips.

title.zh-TW: 修復終端機游標錯位與換行，完善表情符號與多語字元排版
title.en: Fix terminal cursor misalignment and line wrapping, improving emoji and multilingual character layouts

body.zh-TW:
在終端機處理多國文字與圖示時，字寬計算誤差常導致游標跑位或排版錯亂。

調整視窗（停在 `↑ N more lines` 或框外）、提示過高、按上下鍵移至中日韓或表情符號，以及進入 Vim 視覺模式時游標不再錯位，過長的補全提示也會自動縮短。

在支援圖素叢集寬度的終端機中，從外部編輯器（`Ctrl+G`）或 `Ctrl+Z` 返回後及在 tmux 3.6+ 下，含 👩💻、👍🏽、⚠️ 的行不再漂移。在日中韓語系（如 `LANG=ja_JP.UTF-8`）下含 `→`、`…`、`─`、`•` 時的漂移與提早折行也一併修復。

按方向鍵、`Backspace` 或 `Delete` 不再只刪改半個表情符號、旗幟或變音字母，行末寬字元也會正確折行。在 `/diff` 與 `/artifact` 預覽中，結合符號或零寬字元導致提早折行、空白列或過早以 `…` 截斷也已修好。
body.en:
When handling multilingual text and symbols in the terminal, character width calculation errors often lead to cursor displacement or layout glitches.

The cursor no longer misaligns when resizing the window (resting on `↑ N more lines` or outside the frame), when prompts are excessively tall, when pressing Up or Down keys across CJK characters or emojis, or when entering Vim visual mode. Excessively long completion hints will also automatically shrink.

In terminals supporting grapheme cluster widths, lines containing 👩💻, 👍🏽, or ⚠️ no longer drift after returning from an external editor (`Ctrl+G`) or `Ctrl+Z`, or under tmux 3.6+. Drifting and premature line wraps when containing `→`, `…`, `─`, or `•` under CJK locales (such as `LANG=ja_JP.UTF-8`) have also been fixed.

Pressing arrow keys, `Backspace`, or `Delete` no longer modifies or deletes half of an emoji, flag, or accented letter, and wide characters at line ends now wrap correctly. In `/diff` and `/artifact` previews, premature line wrapping, blank lines, or early truncation with `…` caused by combining characters or zero-width characters have also been fixed.

items.original:
Fixed the prompt cursor appearing in the wrong place after resizing the terminal (sometimes on the `↑ N more lines` indicator or below the input box), when a slash command's completion hint didn't fit on the last line of the prompt (the hint is now shortened or left out), when the prompt was taller than the terminal, after pressing `Up` or `Down` onto a line with CJK characters or emoji, and after entering Vim visual mode, which also rewrapped the text.
Fixed the cursor drifting on lines with emoji such as 👩‍💻, 👍🏽, or ⚠️ inside tmux 3.6 and later, and after returning from your external editor (`Ctrl+G`) or a `Ctrl+Z` suspend in terminals that support grapheme-cluster widths.
Fixed the cursor drifting and lines wrapping too early under Japanese, Chinese, or Korean locales such as `LANG=ja_JP.UTF-8` when text contains characters like `→`, `…`, `─`, or `•`, which parts of the CLI counted as two columns wide while the rest drew them as one.
Fixed `Left`, `Right`, `Backspace`, and `Delete` in the prompt and other text boxes moving over or deleting only part of an emoji such as 👩‍💻 or 👍🏽, a flag, or a letter with a combining accent, and fixed text boxes cutting off a wide character, such as a CJK character or emoji, at the end of a wrapped line instead of moving it to the next line.
Fixed lines containing combining marks or other zero-width characters wrapping too early or leaving blank rows in `/diff` and the inline diff preview, and being cut off with `…` too soon in `/artifact` previews.

title.zh-TW: Remote Control 在 daemon 模式下能正常顯示對話紀錄
title.en: Remote Control Displays Conversation History Properly in Daemon Mode

body.zh-TW: 如果你習慣將工具以 daemon（在背景持續運作的服務）模式啟動，再透過 Remote Control 遠端操控介面查看進度，可能曾遇過找不到過去紀錄的狀況。以前在這種背景情境下，Remote Control 不會顯示先前的對話紀錄。現在這個問題已經修復，在 daemon 模式下對話紀錄會正常顯示。
body.en: If you usually launch the tool in daemon mode and check progress through the Remote Control interface, you might have run into cases where past records could not be found. Previously in these background scenarios, Remote Control did not display prior conversation history. This issue has now been fixed, and conversation history displays properly in daemon mode.

items.original: Fixed conversation history not showing in Remote Control in daemon mode.

title.zh-TW: agy plugin validate 擴充檢查範圍，把關技能、子代理與規則設定
title.en: agy plugin validate Expands Check Coverage to Guard Skills, Subagents, and Rule Configurations

body.zh-TW:
打包套件最怕設定缺漏。現在 `agy plugin validate` 會把關技能、子代理與規則。⟦跟遠行清單一樣，以前只看外觀，現在連證件效期都逐項核對，有疏失立刻示警。⟧

`SKILL.md` 缺標頭（frontmatter，檔首宣告）會報錯；缺 `name`、`description`、資料夾名不符、逾 24 KB 或同名略過則警告。
