子代理標頭錯誤、缺欄位、`agent.json` 解析失敗或用保留名報錯；重複名稱、無標頭檔或被忽略的 `agent.json` 則警告。

規則標頭無效或缺 `trigger` 報錯（略過 `README.md`）；缺描述、`globs`、逾 24 KB 或根目錄誤放 `AGENTS.md`、`GEMINI.md` 則警告。
body.en:
Nothing is worse when packaging plugins than missing configuration settings. Now `agy plugin validate` guards skills, subagents, and rules. ⟦Like a travel checklist, it previously only inspected luggage exteriors, but now it verifies document expiration dates item by item and flags any oversight immediately.⟧

A missing `SKILL.md` frontmatter triggers an error. Missing `name` or `description`, folder name mismatches, exceeding 24 KB, or skipped duplicate names trigger warnings.

Subagent frontmatter errors, missing fields, `agent.json` parsing failures, or using reserved names trigger errors. Duplicate names, files without frontmatter, or ignored `agent.json` files trigger warnings.

Invalid rule frontmatter or a missing `trigger` triggers an error (skipping `README.md`). Missing descriptions, missing `globs`, exceeding 24 KB, or mistakenly placing `AGENTS.md` or `GEMINI.md` in the root directory triggers a warning.

items.original: Improved `agy plugin validate` to also check a plugin's skills, subagents, and rules: for skills, it errors on a `SKILL.md` with missing or invalid frontmatter and warns when `name` or `description` is missing, when `name` doesn't match its folder, when the body is over the 24 KB limit, or when a skill in `skills/` is skipped because an earlier skill has the same name; for subagents, it errors on an `agents/` Markdown file with invalid frontmatter or a missing `name` or `description`, an unparseable `agent.json`, or a name reserved for a built-in agent, and warns on duplicate agent names, Markdown files in `agents/` without frontmatter, and `agent.json` files, which the CLI ignores; and for rules, it errors on a rule with invalid frontmatter or without a valid `trigger` (skipping a `README.md` in `rules/` without frontmatter), and warns on a `model_decision` rule without a `description`, a `glob` rule without `globs`, content cut to fit the 24 KB limit, or an `AGENTS.md` or `GEMINI.md` at the plugin root instead of in `rules/`.

title.zh-TW: 檔案行內差異預覽對齊檢視樣式，支援語法高亮與增刪襯色
title.en: Inline File Diff Previews Align with Inspection Styling, Supporting Syntax Highlighting and Tinted Changes

body.zh-TW:
收到代理人請求編輯或建立檔案的確認提示時，你現在能在對話區直接看清每一處改動細節。行內差異預覽（inline diff preview，在對話中直接顯示檔案修改對照的畫面）現在對齊 `/diff` 檢視風格，支援當前配色方案的語法高亮。⟦如同在合約草稿上使用雙色螢光筆批註，以前確認改動只有單調的黑白純文字，現在新增與刪除的行別會以專屬襯色清晰標記，行號欄也保持乾淨不被色彩干擾。⟧

新渲染方式為新增與刪除的程式碼行加上背景襯色。若選用 `Terminal` 配色方案，介面會根據終端機的淺色或深色背景，挑選對比最適當的底色。

畫面左側的行號欄則維持無襯色，避免色塊延伸到邊欄而干擾視線，讓你審查程式碼時更容易對齊行數。
body.en:
When you receive confirmation prompts from agents requesting to edit or create files, you can now see every modification detail directly in the conversation. Inline diff previews (screens showing file modifications directly in the conversation) now align with the `/diff` inspection style and support syntax highlighting for the active color scheme. ⟦Picture annotating a contract draft with two-color highlighters: confirming changes previously relied on monotonous black-and-white plain text, but added and deleted lines are now clearly marked with dedicated tints, while the line number column stays clean and free from distracting color.⟧

The new rendering method adds background tints to added and deleted code lines. If the `Terminal` color scheme is selected, the interface selects the most suitable contrast tint based on whether the terminal background is light or dark.

The line number column on the left side of the screen remains untinted, preventing colored blocks from bleeding into the margin and distracting your gaze, making it easier to track line numbers during code reviews.

items.original: Improved the inline diff preview when the agent asks to edit or create a file so it renders like the `/diff` file view, with syntax highlighting for your color scheme, background tints on added and removed lines (picked from your terminal's light or dark background when using the `Terminal` color scheme), and an untinted line-number gutter.

title.zh-TW: 終端機渲染機制調整，降低打字與執行時的 CPU 消耗
title.en: Terminal Rendering Adjustments Reduce CPU Consumption During Typing and Execution

body.zh-TW:
頻繁在終端機輸入長篇文字或等待背景運算時，你的電腦不會再莫名感受到風扇狂轉的散熱壓力。現在提示區在每個影格只渲染一次，跨影格時也會直接重用未變更文字列的測量寬度。⟦好比翻閱逐格動畫冊，以前每翻一頁就把整面黑板全擦乾淨、逐字重新測量重寫，現在沒變動的段落直接保留，動態跑馬燈也整段套色，不再一個字一個字慢慢畫。⟧

底端的動態狀態列（status line，終端機底端提示執行進度的橫列）過去是一次渲染一個字元，現在改為依相同樣式區段批次繪製。

排版優化減少了重繪時的重複計算，使你在終端機打字或等待回覆時的 CPU 使用率顯著降低。
body.en:
When frequently typing long passages into the terminal or waiting on background computations, your computer will no longer endure spinning cooling fans from thermal strain. The prompt area now renders only once per frame and reuses measured widths of unchanged text rows across frames. ⟦Think of flipping through an animation flipbook: previously, every page turn wiped the entire chalkboard clean to remeasure and rewrite character by character, but unchanged sections are now retained directly, and dynamic banners are styled as entire spans rather than drawn slowly glyph by glyph.⟧

The dynamic status line (the bar at the bottom of the terminal displaying execution progress) previously rendered one character at a time, but now batches rendering by identically styled segments.

Layout optimizations reduce redundant computations during redraws, noticeably lowering CPU usage while typing in the terminal or waiting for responses.

items.original: Improved CPU usage while typing and while the agent is working by rendering the prompt area once per frame, reusing measured line widths for unchanged rows across frames, and rendering the animated status line in styled runs instead of one character at a time.

title.zh-TW: 企業帳號鎖定遙測為關閉，初次設定移除一般遙測勾選框
title.en: Enterprise Accounts Lock Telemetry Off, Removing Consumer Telemetry Checkbox from Initial Setup

body.zh-TW:
如果你平時使用企業帳號或 Google Cloud 專案登入工具，設定介面現在會明確反映資料隱私政策。企業帳號與透過 `AGY_ADC_AUTH` 登入的環境本就絕不收集提詞、檔案內容或模型回覆，但先前在 `/config` 設定選單裡，遙測開關（telemetry，軟體回傳診斷與使用數據的機制）卻仍處於可切換狀態。⟦就像公務用車配有不可關閉的資安規格，以前面板開關還能隨意撥動讓人困惑，現在直接固定在關閉檔位並貼上說明，交車時也不再附上一般民眾的意向調查表。⟧

現在 `/config` 中的 `Enable Telemetry` 列已改為顯示 `off (disabled)`，並附帶文字說明鎖定原因。

初次執行並透過 `AGY_ADC_AUTH` 初始化設定時，畫面僅會顯示 Google Cloud Platform 服務條款，直接移除一般消費者的遙測授權核取方塊。
body.en:
If you routinely log in using an enterprise account or a Google Cloud project, the settings interface now explicitly reflects data privacy policies. Enterprise accounts and environments authenticated via `AGY_ADC_AUTH` never collect prompts, file contents, or model responses in the first place, yet the telemetry toggle (a mechanism transmitting diagnostic and usage metrics) remained switchable inside the `/config` settings menu. ⟦Consider an official fleet vehicle equipped with non-toggleable security standards: previously, the dashboard switch could be toggled at will to everyone's confusion, but it is now locked in the off position with an explanation attached, and delivery no longer includes an optional consumer survey form.⟧

The `Enable Telemetry` row in `/config` now displays `off (disabled)` accompanied by text explaining the reason for the lock.

During initial launch and configuration setup via `AGY_ADC_AUTH`, the screen displays only the Google Cloud Platform Terms of Service, outright removing the standard consumer telemetry consent checkbox.

items.original: Fixed `Enable Telemetry` in `/config` remaining editable for Business accounts (such as Google Cloud project and Application Default Credentials sign-in via `AGY_ADC_AUTH`), where prompts, content, and model responses are never collected: the row now shows `off (disabled)` and explains why, and first-run setup with `AGY_ADC_AUTH` now shows the Google Cloud Platform Terms of Service without the consumer telemetry opt-in checkbox.

title.zh-TW: 舊版 Windows 遇沙盒限制改為執行前確認，設定面板隱藏不相容選項
title.en: Older Windows Falls Back to Pre-Execution Prompts Under Sandbox Limits, Hiding Incompatible Settings

body.zh-TW:
在 Windows 10 或尚未升級至 24H2 的 Windows 11 電腦上操作時，指令執行不再因為作業系統缺少沙盒支援而動彈不得。以前若在此類系統選取了沙盒權限模式，終端機隔離防護（terminal sandbox，將指令限制在受控邊界內執行的安全環境）會因環境不支援而導致代理人指令啟動失敗。⟦與遊樂設施的安全門檢驗相似，以前遇到感測器規格不符的舊閘道會直接卡死鎖上，現在設施會自動切回人工驗票口，購票面板也不再列出無法支援的感應手環選項。⟧

現在命令列會自動關閉終端機沙盒，啟動備援措施，改為在執行各項指令前先跳出確認提示。

遠端控制（Remote Control）在瀏覽器中的設定彈窗，也會直接在此類系統上隱藏沙盒權限選項，避免誤選無效設定。
body.en:
When operating on Windows 10 or Windows 11 PCs not yet upgraded to 24H2, command execution will no longer stall because the operating system lacks sandbox support. Previously, selecting sandbox permission mode on such systems caused terminal sandboxing (a secure environment confining commands within controlled boundaries) to fail during agent command startup due to lack of environment support. ⟦Just as an amusement park ride manages safety gates, older turnstiles with incompatible sensors previously locked up completely, but the attraction now falls back to a manual ticket gate and removes unsupported wristband options from the ticket kiosk.⟧

The command line now automatically disables the terminal sandbox and activates a fallback, prompting for confirmation before executing each command instead.

The Remote Control settings popover in the browser also hides the sandbox permission option on such systems, preventing accidental selection of invalid settings.

items.original: Fixed agent commands failing to start on Windows versions that don't support the terminal sandbox (Windows 10 and Windows 11 before version 24H2) when a sandboxed permission mode was selected: the CLI now turns off the terminal sandbox and falls back to asking before running commands, and the Remote Control browser Settings modal hides sandboxed permission options on those systems.

title.zh-TW: 網路斷線改為自動重試，筆電休眠或換網不再中斷工作
title.en: Network Disconnections Trigger Automatic Retries, Keeping Work Intact Across Laptop Sleep and Network Switches

body.zh-TW:
帶著筆電在不同會議室間移動，或是闔上螢幕喚醒電腦後，交給代理人執行到一半的任務不會再輕易中斷。以往當系統碰上網路連線端點（socket，程式之間建立連線傳輸資料的介面）斷線，例如筆電休眠或切換 Wi-Fi 後觸發的 `broken pipe`、`software caused connection abort`、`network is down` 或 `http2: client connection lost`，對話會直接以錯誤訊息終止。⟦遇上長途通話訊號不穩時，以前只要路過隧道斷訊一瞬間電話就直接被掛斷，現在通話軟體會先在背景自動重新撥號嘗試接回，真的連不上才會跳出撥打失敗的警示。⟧

現在工具遇到此類斷線錯誤時，會在背景自動展開重新連線重試。

只有在重試依然無法建立連線時，代理人才會回報網路錯誤，不再因為短暫的網路波動而拋棄整輪進度。
body.en:
When moving a laptop between conference rooms or waking it after closing the lid, tasks handed off to the agent will no longer easily abort midstream. Previously, when the system encountered network socket disconnections (interfaces establishing connections to transfer data between programs)—such as `broken pipe`, `software caused connection abort`, `network is down`, or `http2: client connection lost` triggered after laptop sleep or switching Wi-Fi—the conversation terminated outright with an error. ⟦During an unstable long-distance phone call, passing through a tunnel previously dropped the line the moment the signal cut out, but calling software now redials automatically in the background to reconnect, displaying a call failure alert only when connection truly fails.⟧

When tools encounter these disconnection errors now, they automatically initiate reconnection retries in the background.

Only if retries still fail to establish a connection will the agent report a network error, no longer discarding an entire round of progress over momentary network fluctuations.

items.original: Fixed socket disconnect errors such as `broken pipe`, `software caused connection abort`, `network is down`, and `http2: client connection lost` (for example after laptop sleep or a Wi-Fi change) stopping the turn with `Agent execution terminated due to error.` instead of retrying automatically and reporting a network error if retries fail.

title.zh-TW: 修復 MCP 工具管線：當機即時標示錯誤，大筆資料不再繞過上限
title.en: Fix MCP Tool Pipeline: Immediate Crash Errors and Enforced Limits on Large Payloads

body.zh-TW:
串接服務或查詢大筆資料時，現在連線防護與記憶管理更穩固。使用 MCP 工具（Model Context Protocol，讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）時，過去伺服器行程意外終止，`/mcp` 仍顯示為 `Ready`，導致後續工具呼叫失敗跳出 `client is closing: EOF`；現在會標記為 `Error` 並清除已關閉的工作階段。⟦比照工廠外接儀器，跳電時控制板亮故障燈並切斷線路，不再假裝正常；傳送超長數據時也依規矩截切，不再塞爆暫存區。⟧

針對大型 JSON 等結構化資料，過去即便計為截斷，仍繞過單步計費單位（token，AI 處理與計費的文字單位）限制，導致長對話在自動壓縮前就塞爆模型視窗；現在已嚴格遵守單步上限。
body.en:
Connecting services or querying large datasets now features sturdier connection protection and memory management. When using MCP tools (Model Context Protocol, a protocol connecting AI to external tools), unexpected server process terminations previously left `/mcp` displaying `Ready`, causing subsequent tool calls to fail with `client is closing: EOF`. The interface now marks them as `Error` and cleans up closed sessions. ⟦Much as external factory instruments behave, the control board illuminates a fault indicator and disconnects the line during a power trip instead of pretending normal operation, and it truncates oversized data streams by rule instead of overflowing the buffer.⟧

For structured data such as large JSON payloads, requests previously bypassed single-step token limits (text units for AI processing and billing) even when marked as truncated, overflowing the model context window before auto-compaction could trigger. The pipeline now strictly enforces single-step limits.

items.original:
Fixed an MCP server continuing to show as `Ready` in `/mcp` after its process exited unexpectedly, which left later tool calls failing with `client is closing: EOF`; the server is now marked as `Error` and its closed session is removed.
Fixed large structured tool outputs (such as JSON results from MCP tools) bypassing the per-step token limit while still being counted as truncated, which could push long conversations past the model's context window before automatic compaction ran.

title.zh-TW: 回覆中含分號的超連結不再被截斷，點擊可開啟完整網址
title.en: Hyperlinks with Semicolons in Responses No Longer Truncate, Opening Complete URLs on Click

body.zh-TW: 點擊終端機回覆中的網頁超連結時，網址參數不再因為包含特殊符號而意外遺失。以前在部分終端機或終端多工器（terminal multiplexer，能在單一視窗切割管理多個工作階段的工具）中，若代理人提供的網址包含分號 `;`，點擊後網址常在第一個分號處被硬生生截斷，導致瀏覽器開啟無效頁面。這個問題已經修好，現在包含分號的完整網址都能正確開啟。
body.en: When clicking web hyperlinks in terminal responses, URL parameters are no longer lost to special characters. In certain terminals or terminal multiplexers (tools dividing and managing multiple sessions in a single window), URLs provided by the agent that contained a semicolon `;` were previously cut short at the first semicolon when clicked, causing browsers to open invalid pages. This issue has been fixed, and complete URLs containing semicolons now open properly.

items.original: Fixed clickable links in agent responses whose URL contains `;` opening a URL cut off at the first `;` in terminals and multiplexers that split link sequences on semicolons.

title.zh-TW: /title 與 /remote-control 支援大寫開關指令，輸入 ON 不再報錯
title.en: /title and /remote-control Support Uppercase Toggles, No Longer Erroring on ON

body.zh-TW: 隨手在終端機輸入斜線指令調整功能時，你不再需要小心翼翼確認大小寫鎖定鍵。以前使用 `/title` 設定標題，或是使用 `/remote-control` 開啟遠端控制時，若輸入了大寫的開關參數（例如輸入 `/title ON` 或 `/remote-control Off`），指令會直接判定無效並拒絕執行。這個問題已經修好，現在無論輸入大寫或小寫的開關文字，指令都能正確識別並順利切換。
body.en: When typing slash commands into the terminal to adjust settings, you no longer need to double-check Caps Lock. Previously, when using `/title` to set titles or `/remote-control` to enable remote control, entering uppercase toggle arguments (such as `/title ON` or `/remote-control Off`) caused commands to be flagged as invalid and rejected outright. This issue has been resolved, and commands now correctly recognize and toggle settings regardless of whether uppercase or lowercase text is supplied.

items.original: Fixed `/title` and `/remote-control` rejecting `on` and `off` when typed with uppercase letters, such as `/title ON` or `/remote-control Off`.

title.zh-TW: 無頭模式等待背景工作接續對話，逾時中斷改回傳錯誤
title.en: Headless mode waits for background follow-up turns and exits with error on timeout

body.zh-TW: 當你寫腳本透過指令列自動處理任務時，最怕背景工作還沒做完程式就提早離場。使用 `grok -p` 啟動無頭模式（沒有終端機畫面的執行模式）時，若已完成的背景工作觸發了接續對話，現在會耐心等待該輪對話結束後才退出。⟦如同自助洗衣機的運轉流程，以前主行程一結束就立刻切斷電源，不管追加的防皺運轉跑完了沒有；現在機器會等接續動作徹底收尾才關機，要是設定的時間上限強行中斷了未完工項，面板更會亮起錯誤紅燈而不是回報順利完成。⟧如果加上 `--background-wait-timeout` 參數且因逾時停止了待處理工作，程式結束時會回傳錯誤代碼，不再誤報為成功執行。
body.en: When scripting automated tasks through the command line, the biggest risk is a process exiting prematurely before background work finishes. When launching headless mode (an execution mode with no terminal screen) with `grok -p`, if completed background tasks trigger follow-up conversation turns, the runner now waits patiently for that turn to conclude before exiting. ⟦Like the cycle of a laundromat washing machine, the power previously cut off the moment the main cycle finished, regardless of whether the extra anti-wrinkle cycle had completed; now the machine shuts down only after follow-up actions wrap up completely, and if a configured time limit forcibly stops unfinished work, the panel flashes a red error light instead of reporting a successful run.⟧ If you provide the `--background-wait-timeout` option and pending work is stopped due to a timeout, the program now exits with an error code instead of falsely reporting success.

items.original: Headless mode (`grok -p`) waits for the follow-up turn that a finished background task starts before exiting, and a `--background-wait-timeout` that stops pending work exits with an error instead of success

title.zh-TW: 儀表板冷啟動恢復工作階段，保持浮層開啟並支援按鍵返回
title.en: Dashboard cold boot resumes sessions while keeping popover open with keyboard back navigation

body.zh-TW: 你在儀表板翻找過去的歷史紀錄時，可能會想先點進某個舊存檔看看進度。在儀表板浮層中針對未預載的存檔執行冷啟動 `/resume` 時，介面現在會讓浮動面板保持附著開啟。⟦彷彿在電子導覽機前點選歷史路徑，以前只要觸控未預載的深層檔案，選單面板就會冷不防關閉脫離，讓人想反悔返回都無從按起；現在清單畫面會持續固定在視野中，隨時都能按上一頁安全退回。⟧如此一來，載入舊工作階段時不會丟失操作畫面，你可以隨時按下向左方向鍵（Left）或 `Ctrl+\` 順利退出，返回原本的清單繼續瀏覽。
body.en: When browsing past history in the dashboard, you might want to open an older saved state to inspect its progress. Triggering a cold `/resume` on an unloaded session from the dashboard popover now keeps the floating panel open and attached. ⟦At a digital directory kiosk, tapping an unloaded deep record previously caused the menu panel to snap shut and detach unexpectedly, leaving no way to step back; now the list display stays anchored in view so you can safely return at any moment.⟧ This way, you never lose your context when loading an older session, and you can press the Left arrow key (Left) or `Ctrl+\` at any time to exit cleanly and return to the list.

items.original: Cold `/resume` from the dashboard overlay keeps the overlay attached, so you can still back out with Left or `Ctrl+\`

title.zh-TW: 選取帶參數斜線指令按 Enter 直接執行，不再殘留空格
title.en: Selecting slash commands with arguments and pressing Enter executes immediately without trailing spaces

body.zh-TW: 在終端機輸入框使用斜線指令時，大家常會透過選單挑選想跑的動作。當你在提示詞撰寫區反白選取帶有可選參數的斜線指令並按下 Enter 鍵時，現在會立刻執行該指令。以前輸入框（composer，撰寫提示詞的文字區）只會在指令後面留下一格多餘的空格，停在原地等待你再次確認。⟦好比在車載導航螢幕上選取附帶途經點的路線，以前按下確認鈕，畫面只會在輸入欄末端留下一格空白等候；現在一按便直接開始指引，不再卡在輸入框等待多餘的操作。⟧這樣不必在選好指令後還得手動多敲一次鍵，命令一選定就能順暢送出。
body.en: When using slash commands in the terminal input box, users often pick actions from the menu. Selecting a slash command with optional arguments in the prompt area and pressing Enter now executes that command immediately. Previously, the composer (the text area for writing prompts) only appended an extra space after the command, sitting idle while waiting for your confirmation. ⟦On an in-car navigation screen, selecting a route with waypoints and hitting confirm previously only left a blank space at the end of the input field; now a single press starts guidance immediately instead of stalling for redundant input.⟧ You no longer need to press an extra key manually after choosing a command, allowing selected actions to submit smoothly.

items.original: Enter on a highlighted slash command with optional arguments runs the command instead of leaving a trailing space in the composer

title.zh-TW: 多項 CLI 指令支援管道提早關閉與串流限制，避免輸出異常崩潰
title.en: Multiple CLI commands handle early pipe closures and stream limits without crashing

body.zh-TW: 平時在終端機串接多道指令過濾資料時，下游工具提早結束往往會引發非預期的中斷。包含 `grok models`、列出工作階段的 `grok sessions` 與 `grok export` 等指令，當輸出管道提早關閉（例如串接 `head` 只取前幾行）或輸出裝置已滿時，現在都不再發生當機。⟦就像工廠輸送帶上的分裝包裝線，以前只要下游集貨箱裝滿或接收閘門提早關閉，傳送機械便會當場卡死並引發整條產線警報；現在機台一旦察覺出口無法收件，就會平順停止輸出並安穩關機。⟧`grok update` 與 `grok login` 兩項指令在標準輸出（stdout）或標準錯誤關閉且無法寫入時，現在同樣能安全結束，確保批次腳本不再因串流截斷而崩潰。
body.en: When piping multiple commands in the terminal to filter data, a downstream tool exiting early often triggers unexpected disruptions. Commands including `grok models`, `grok sessions` for listing sessions, and `grok export` no longer crash when their output pipe closes early (such as when piped into `head` for the first few lines) or when the output device fills up. ⟦In a factory conveyor packaging line, if a downstream collection bin filled up or a receiving gate closed early, the transport machinery previously jammed on the spot and triggered plant-wide alarms; now the equipment halts output smoothly and shuts down safely as soon as it detects that the exit cannot accept packages.⟧ `grok update` and `grok login` now also exit safely when standard output (stdout) or standard error is closed and unwritable, ensuring batch scripts no longer crash due to truncated streams.

items.original:
CLI commands such as `grok models`, `grok sessions` and `grok export` no longer crash when their output pipe closes early, such as when piped to `head`, or when the output device is full
`grok update` and `grok login` no longer crash when stdout or stderr is closed or unwritable

title.zh-TW: /resume 精確比對單一工作階段直接開啟，選單支援任意詞序搜尋
title.en: /resume Directly Resumes an Exact Single-Session Match and Supports Any-Word-Order Search in the Picker

body.zh-TW: 當你累積了大量對話紀錄想重新接續進度時，不必再忍受死板的關鍵字順序或多餘的確認步驟。⟦翻找辦公室抽屜裡的專案夾時，以前封面標題上的單字順序只要顛倒就翻不出來，就算報出唯一編號也非得拉開整個清單；現在只要寫齊關鍵字無論順序都能對應，代碼剛好只吻合一份時更能直接抽取出夾。⟧現在在終端機輸入 `/resume <id or name>` 時，只要指定的 ID 或標題剛好只吻合單一工作階段，Grok Build 就會直接進入該工作階段，不再每次都強制彈出挑選器讓你多點一次。如果呼叫挑選器手動尋找，只要輸入的內容包含標題中的每一個單字，無論先後順序為何，挑選器都能精確列出符合的工作階段。
body.en: When you have accumulated a large conversation history and want to resume progress, you no longer have to endure rigid keyword ordering or redundant confirmation steps. ⟦Picture someone searching for a project folder in an office drawer. Previously, if the word order on the cover was reversed, it could not be found, and reciting a unique number still required opening the entire list. Now, entering all keywords matches regardless of sequence, and matching exactly one code lets you pull the folder straight out.⟧ Now when you enter `/resume <id or name>` in the terminal, as long as the specified ID or title matches exactly one session, Grok Build directly enters that session instead of forcing a picker popup every time for an extra click. If you bring up the picker to search manually, the picker accurately lists matching sessions as long as your input includes every word in the title, regardless of their order.

items.original:
Resume picker finds sessions whose titles contain every word you type, in any order
`/resume <id or name>` opens the session directly when the ID or title matches exactly one session, instead of always opening the picker

title.zh-TW: 儀表板預覽文字支援滑鼠拖曳，放開即自動複製到剪貼簿
title.en: Dashboard Preview Text Supports Mouse Dragging, Automatically Copying to the Clipboard on Release

body.zh-TW: 想要從儀表板快速擷取一段預覽內容轉貼給同事時，現在不需要再按任何鍵盤快捷鍵。⟦拿著螢光筆在文件上劃記重點時，以前畫完標記還得手動按相機快門留底；現在筆尖劃過文字並在放開筆桿時，內容就自動傳送至隨身筆記。⟧在儀表板檢視預覽文字時，你可以直接按住滑鼠游標拖曳選取想要的字串。只要在選取完成後放開滑鼠按鍵，被標記的文字片段就會自動複製到剪貼簿。無論是需要摘錄報錯內容還是比對執行結果，拖曳選取後就能直接切換到其他對話視窗貼上，省下反白後還要按鍵複製的瑣碎手續。
body.en: When you want to quickly grab preview content from the dashboard to paste for a colleague, you no longer need to press any keyboard shortcuts. ⟦Imagine marking highlights on a document with a highlighter. Previously, after finishing the mark, you still had to press a camera shutter manually to keep a record; now, as the pen tip glides across the text and releases, the content is transmitted automatically to a pocket notebook.⟧ While viewing preview text on the dashboard, you can click and drag the mouse cursor to select the desired string. As soon as you release the mouse button after completing the selection, the marked text snippet is automatically copied to the clipboard. Whether you need to extract error details or compare execution results, you can paste directly into another chat window right after dragging to select, saving the tedious step of pressing keys to copy after highlighting.

items.original: Dashboard peek text can be selected by dragging over it with the mouse, and the selection is copied to the clipboard when you release

title.zh-TW: 工作流程檢視向下滾動名冊時，畫面持續朝較新代理人平順推進
title.en: Workflow View Smoothly Advances Toward Newer Agents When Scrolling Down the Roster

body.zh-TW: 追蹤多個代理人協同運作的工作流程時，檢視進度最怕視窗畫面不聽使喚。⟦順著排隊走道向前推動檢視鏡頭時，以前只要滾輪往下滾動，視野就冷不防被彈簧拉回起點；現在畫面會依循操作，順暢朝著後方新加入的成員推進。⟧在工作流程的執行檢視畫面中，當你在代理人名冊上向下滾動滑鼠滾輪時，畫面現在會順著操作方向持續朝向較新的代理人捲動，而不是突然彈回原處。這讓你在依序盤點每個代理人的最新執行進度時，視野能夠一路平穩跟隨，不必反覆重新尋找焦點。
body.en: When tracking a workflow where multiple agents collaborate, the biggest frustration when checking progress is an uncooperative viewport. ⟦Think of tracking an inspection camera forward along a queue corridor. Previously, whenever the scroll wheel moved downward, the view was abruptly pulled back to the starting point like a spring; now, the frame follows the action, smoothly advancing toward newly joined members at the rear.⟧ In the workflow execution view, when you scroll down on the agent roster with the mouse wheel, the view now continuously scrolls toward newer agents in the direction of your movement, rather than snapping back to the origin. This allows your line of sight to smoothly follow along as you inspect each agent's latest execution progress in sequence, without having to repeatedly hunt for focus.

items.original: Workflow run views scroll toward newer agents when you wheel down the agent roster, instead of snapping back

title.zh-TW: Windows 執行掛鉤失敗時點名未啟動的程式，不再誤指指令碼出錯
title.en: Windows Identifies Unstarted Programs When Hook Execution Fails, Rather Than Blaming the Script

body.zh-TW: 在 Windows 環境下使用掛鉤（在特定事件發生時被觸發的小程式）除錯自動化流程時，最怕看到語意模糊的錯誤訊息。⟦呼叫外勤車隊出門執行任務時，以前只要外包貨車在門口無法發動，控制台卻只會回報派工單寫錯；現在通報會明確點名是哪一輛車發動失敗，不再冤枉原本寫好的任務清單。⟧在 Windows 系統中若掛鉤產生行程失敗，終端機現在會直接點名究竟是哪個外部程式無法啟動，例如具體標示出 PowerShell 或 Git Bash 發生錯誤，而不是怪罪掛鉤指令稿本身。面對這類問題時，你能立刻看出是環境缺少執行工具還是路徑設定遺漏，省下逐行檢查指令碼內容的時間。
body.en: When debugging automated workflows on Windows using hooks (small programs triggered by specific events), the worst experience is seeing ambiguous error messages. ⟦Dispatching a field fleet for a mission previously meant that whenever an outsourced truck failed to start at the gate, the control center only reported an error in the work order; now, the alert clearly names which vehicle failed to start without falsely blaming the original task list.⟧ If a hook fails to spawn a process on Windows, the terminal now directly names which external program failed to start, such as specifically indicating an error in PowerShell or Git Bash, rather than blaming the hook script itself. When confronting such issues, you can immediately tell whether the environment lacks an execution tool or is missing a path configuration, saving time spent inspecting the script line by line.

items.original: Hook spawn failures on Windows name the program that failed to start, such as PowerShell or Git Bash, instead of blaming the hook script

title.zh-TW: grok --resume 依更新時間排序工作階段，找不到本機紀錄時即刻回報
title.en: grok --resume sorts sessions by update time and immediately reports when local records are missing

body.zh-TW:
當你累積了大量對話想重新接續先前的工作進度，只憑模糊印象輸入名稱往往難以精準定位。⟦如同在圖書館櫃檯查詢借閱紀錄，以前一旦館內找不到藏書，館方電腦便主動發起外館調閱並要求重新刷卡驗證；現在螢幕直接按最後更新時間由近到遠條列項目，若沒有相符紀錄還會提示相近名稱，找不到時立即告知結果。⟧

執行 `grok --resume <title>` 恢復對話時，列出的相符工作階段會依據最後更新時間由新到舊排序，並清楚附上各自的最近更新時間。要是輸入的名稱完全沒有符合的紀錄，命令列會主動推薦相似的標題供你挑選。

當指定的標題在本地電腦中完全不存在時，命令列現在會立即回報未找到，而不是嘗試發起遠端還原程序並要求你登入帳號。
body.en:
When you have accumulated many conversations and want to resume earlier progress, typing a name from vague memory often makes precise targeting difficult. ⟦Think of checking borrowing records at a library counter. Previously, whenever a book was missing from the collection, the computer initiated an interlibrary loan and required card reverification; now, the screen lists items from newest to oldest by last update time, suggests similar names if no record matches, and reports the result immediately when nothing is found.⟧

When running `grok --resume <title>` to resume a conversation, matching sessions are listed in order from newest to oldest based on their last update time, clearly displaying their respective recent update times. If the entered name has no matching records at all, the command line recommends similar titles for you to choose from.

When the specified title does not exist at all on the local machine, the command line now immediately reports that it was not found, instead of attempting to initiate a remote restore process and asking you to log in.

items.original:
`grok --resume <title>` lists matching sessions newest first with when each was last updated, and suggests similar titles when nothing matches
`grok --resume <title>` with a title that matches no local session reports the miss right away instead of trying a remote restore and asking you to sign in

title.zh-TW: 全螢幕 Markdown 檢視器按 Shift+Y 複製游標所在的程式碼區塊
title.en: Full-screen Markdown viewer copies the code block under the cursor with Shift+Y

body.zh-TW:
閱讀長篇技術文件或檢視終端機輸出時，切換到全螢幕檢視器能讓排版更為乾淨，但想取用其中的範例段落往往需要額外步驟。⟦彷彿拿著手持掃描器在貨架間盤點，以前想記錄規格得拿出紙筆沿著邊界逐字謄寫，現在光點只要對準商品標籤扣下按鍵，整組資料便立刻收進隨身清單。⟧

在全螢幕 Markdown 檢視器中，現在只要將游標移動到目標程式碼上方，按下快捷鍵 `Shift+Y`，就會複製游標所在的整個程式碼區塊。如此一來，閱讀長篇文件時便能直接擷取所需的指令或程式碼片段，不必再特地動用滑鼠手動框選。
body.en:
When reading long technical documents or inspecting terminal output, switching to a full-screen viewer keeps the layout cleaner, but grabbing example passages often takes extra steps. ⟦Picture taking inventory among store shelves with a handheld scanner. Previously, recording specifications meant pulling out pen and paper to transcribe character by character along the margins; now, aiming the light beam at a product label and pressing a button instantly pulls the whole dataset into a portable list.⟧

In the full-screen Markdown viewer, moving the cursor over target code and pressing `Shift+Y` now copies the entire code block beneath the cursor. Reading long documents this way lets you capture needed commands or snippets directly without reaching for a mouse to highlight them manually.

items.original: `Shift+Y` in the fullscreen markdown viewer copies the code block under the cursor

title.zh-TW: 從儀表板開啟工作階段時，按 Esc 聚焦回捲歷程而非退回儀表板
title.en: Pressing Esc focuses scrollback instead of returning to dashboard when opening a session

body.zh-TW:
從儀表板開啟特定工作階段準備輸入指令時，要是想先檢閱先前的上下文，直覺按鍵往往可能帶來非預期的畫面切換。⟦跟參觀特展展示台一樣，以前在互動導覽的第一道題目按下返回鍵，畫面會冷不防退回接待大廳；現在只會把檢視游標移到上方的過往解說板，與獨立參觀時的行為完全相同。⟧

以前從儀表板開啟工作階段後，若在第一個提問處按下 `Esc`，畫面會直接關閉並退回儀表板。現在按下 `Esc` 時，焦點會切換到上方儲存的回捲歷程（scrollback，可往上捲動查看歷史輸出的區域）。這樣的一致行為與直接在終端機啟動的獨立工作階段相同，避免你為了查看先前的對話而中斷手頭上的流程。
body.en:
When opening a session from the dashboard to enter commands, intuitive keystrokes can often trigger unexpected view switches if you want to inspect earlier context first. ⟦Like visiting a special exhibition booth, pressing back at the first question of an interactive guide used to kick you back to the reception hall without warning; now, it only shifts the viewing cursor up to the previous display board, behaving exactly like a self-guided tour.⟧

Previously, after opening a session from the dashboard, pressing `Esc` at the first prompt would close the view and return directly to the dashboard. Now, pressing `Esc` shifts focus to the saved scrollback (the buffer area for scrolling up to inspect past output). This consistent behavior matches standalone sessions started directly in the terminal, preventing interruptions to your workflow when you only want to review prior dialogue.

items.original: `Esc` on the first question in a session opened from the dashboard moves focus to the scrollback, as it does in a standalone session, instead of returning to the dashboard

title.zh-TW: /blender 指令登場，參考圖直接重建為 3D 可編輯場景
title.en: /blender Command Debuts to Reconstruct Reference Images Directly into Editable 3D Scenes

body.zh-TW: 當你手邊有一張概念設計圖或參考照片，想快速建立立體模型時，往往需要在建模程式裡從零搭建物件與燈光。新推出的 `/blender` 指令能依據參考圖片，自動重建出可自由編輯的 Blender（一套開源三維繪圖工具）場景。⟦就像拿著一張平面設計草圖走進工作室，模型師當場組裝出能拆卸零件、隨意更換視角的立體模型。⟧這讓你省去繁瑣的手動對位，產出的檔案也能立刻在編輯器內接續調整視角、材質與燈光。
body.en:
When you have a concept design sketch or reference photo and want to quickly create a 3D model, you often need to build objects and lighting from scratch in modeling software. The newly introduced `/blender` command automatically reconstructs a freely editable Blender (an open-source 3D modeling tool) scene based on reference images.

⟦Picture walking into a studio with a 2D design sketch, where a modeler immediately assembles a 3D model with detachable parts and freely adjustable viewing angles on the spot.⟧

This saves you from tedious manual alignment, and the generated files can immediately be used to adjust perspectives, materials, and lighting directly in the editor.

items.original: Added `/blender` to reconstruct reference images as editable Blender scenes

title.zh-TW: 電腦操作精簡工具呼叫，跳過重複查閱與多餘清單直奔目標
title.en: Computer Use Streamlines Tool Calls, Skipping Redundant Checks and Lists to Head Straight for Goals

body.zh-TW: 讓 AI 代理操作桌面螢幕時，每多呼叫一次工具，都會拉長等待時間並消耗額度。電腦操作（Computer Use，讓 AI 透過視覺畫面模擬人類點擊與輸入的機制）現在減少了許多冗餘的工具呼叫。當任務明確指定某個應用程式時，它會直接啟動該程式，不再先列出所有應用程式清單；遇到檔案或系統查詢，會直接以終端機指令回答；它還會跳過重複閱讀自身說明的動作。⟦好比熟練的助理接獲指令便立刻動手，不再反覆翻閱員工手冊或把工具箱裡的物件逐一清點一遍。⟧就算畫面當下看起來像是已經做完，它仍會依照指示確實執行任務。
body.en:
When having an AI agent operate desktop screens, every extra tool call prolongs waiting times and consumes quota. Computer Use (a mechanism that lets AI simulate human clicks and keystrokes through visual screens) now cuts out many redundant tool calls. When a task explicitly specifies an application, it launches that program directly instead of first listing all applications. When encountering file or system queries, it answers directly with terminal commands. It also skips repeatedly re-reading its own instructions.

⟦Think of a skilled assistant getting straight to work upon receiving an order, instead of repeatedly leafing through the employee handbook or counting every item in the toolbox.⟧

Even if the screen currently looks like the task is already finished, it still carries out the assignment faithfully according to instructions.

items.original: Computer Use makes fewer tool calls: it skips re-reading its own instructions, opens the app a task clearly points to without listing apps first, answers file and system questions with the shell, and does the task even when the screen already looks done

title.zh-TW: 背景任務提示頻率降至單次，監聽狀態即刻顯示且長程目標不中斷
title.en: Background Task Prompts Reduced to Once, Displaying Listening States Instantly Without Halting Goal Runs

body.zh-TW: 在終端機啟動耗時較長的工作時，對話視窗的提示頻率與狀態顯示有了更清晰的安排。執行超過 30 分鐘的背景指令，現在只會主動提示代理一次，不再每隔半小時就提醒，需要時由代理自行排定後續檢查時機。當代理收到長時間背景指令的提示時，對話紀錄會顯示「Waiting for background task」，讓你明白它為何開始動作；針對仍在執行的背景指令，重複發出的等待請求也不再卡住整個等待時間。即使電腦負載偏高或硬碟緩慢，新啟動的監聽器也會即刻出現在頁尾與 `/tasks` 清單中。在長程目標模式（goal run，讓 AI 自主推進多步驟目標的執行流程）下，若工具執行後產生了新的下一步指引，它會替換既有指引並繼續前進，不再提早停下；僅在指引完全相同時才會如常停止。
body.en: When launching long-running jobs in the terminal, prompt frequencies and status displays in conversation windows are now arranged much more clearly. Background commands running longer than 30 minutes will now proactively prompt the agent only once instead of reminding it every half hour, leaving the agent to schedule follow-up checks when needed. When an agent receives a prompt for a long-running background command, the conversation log displays "Waiting for background task" so you understand why it started taking action. Repeated wait requests for background commands that are still executing no longer stall the entire wait duration. Even under heavy machine load or slow disk speeds, newly started listeners appear immediately in the footer and the `/tasks` list. In goal run mode (an execution flow where AI autonomously advances multi-step goals), if a tool run produces new next-step guidance, it replaces existing guidance and continues moving forward rather than stopping early. It only stops as usual when the guidance is completely identical.

items.original:
A background command that runs past 30 minutes now prompts the agent once instead of every 30 minutes; the agent schedules its own later check if it needs one
The transcript shows "Waiting for background task" when the agent is prompted about a long-running background command, so you can see why it started working
A duplicate wait for a background command that is still running no longer holds the chat for its full requested wait
A monitor you start now appears in the footer and in `/tasks` right away, even when the machine is busy or the disk is slow
A long goal run no longer stops early when fresh next-step guidance replaces still-active guidance after new tool work; identical guidance still stops as before

title.zh-TW: 沙盒環境嚴格隔離設定目錄，Git 技能禁止擅自隱藏未追蹤檔案
title.en: Sandbox Environment Strictly Isolates Config Directories, Forbidding Git Skill from Hiding Untracked Files

body.zh-TW: 把終端機指令交給 AI 時，機密資料與檔案庫的安全界線至關重要。沙盒（sandbox，隔離執行的受限環境）指令，無法再讀取或修改 `~/.config/muse`、`~/.config/tbh` 或 `XDG_CONFIG_HOME` 下的登入資訊、設定、核准規則與被封鎖程式。任務只要求乾淨工作樹時，Git 技能拒絕用忽略規則或 stash 隱藏未追蹤檔案。掛鉤（hook，特定事件觸發的小程式）參數 `model_provider` 改標註模型供應商；僅 Meta 閘道列為 Meta 擁有的模型回報 `meta`，其餘省略，其上的 Claude 或 GPT 工作階段不再回報為 `meta`。⟦像訪客證開不了保險櫃，清潔工也不准把雜物塞進抽屜掩蓋混亂。⟧
body.en:
When delegating terminal commands to AI, the security boundaries of sensitive credentials and repositories are critical. Sandboxed commands (a restricted environment for isolated execution) can no longer read or modify login credentials, settings, approval rules, or blocked applications under `~/.config/muse`, `~/.config/tbh`, or `XDG_CONFIG_HOME`. When a task only requires a clean worktree, the Git skill refuses to hide untracked files using ignore rules or stash. The hook (a small program triggered by a specific event) parameter `model_provider` now indicates the model provider. Only models listed as Meta-owned by the Meta gateway report `meta`, while others omit it, so Claude or GPT sessions running on it no longer report `meta`.

⟦Just as a visitor badge cannot open a safe, a cleaner is also forbidden to shove clutter into drawers to hide a mess.⟧

items.original:
Security: Sandboxed commands can no longer read or change sign-in details, settings, approval rules or blocked apps stored in `~/.config/muse`, `~/.config/tbh` or the same folders under `XDG_CONFIG_HOME`
Security: The git skill now refuses to hide your untracked files with ignore rules or a stash when a task only asks for a clean tree
Security: Hook input `model_provider` now names the vendor of the selected model instead of the connection it was routed through: it is `meta` only for a model the built-in Meta gateway catalog lists as Meta-owned, and is omitted otherwise, so a Claude or GPT session on the Meta gateway no longer reports `meta`

title.zh-TW: 工作流程子任務獨立重試，崩潰重啟精準標記中斷狀態
title.en: Workflow Subtasks Retry Independently, Accurately Tagging Interrupted States upon Crash Restarts

body.zh-TW: 執行包含多個子任務的工作流程時，單一環節發生中斷不再導致整個流程無故卡死。如果工作流程（Workflow，串聯多個子任務自動化執行的機制）的子任務因啟動紀錄無法儲存，或該任務已存有另一筆不同的啟動紀錄而停止，現在會以白話說明未執行任何新操作、其餘子任務仍持續運作，並指引下一步做法。排定重試後立刻遭中斷的任務，恢復時會依照原記錄的模型與思考力度接續運作。若恢復的任務初次儲存在任何內容寫入前就失敗，僅有該任務會重試而非中斷整個流程；重試的儲存再失敗，也僅標記該任務失敗，並告訴你下一步該怎麼做。遇崩潰重新啟動時，若已終止的代理重啟遭拒，其紀錄列會直接標為失敗並讓整體流程完工，不再誤顯為執行中。
body.en: When executing workflows containing multiple subtasks, an interruption in a single step no longer stalls the entire flow without explanation. If a subtask in a workflow (a mechanism that chains multiple subtasks for automated execution) stops because its launch record cannot be saved, or because a different launch record already exists for it, it now explains in plain language that no new operations were run, confirms that other subtasks are still running, and guides next steps. Tasks interrupted immediately after scheduling a retry will resume operation using the originally recorded model and reasoning effort. If an initial save of a resumed task fails before any content is written, only that task retries instead of interrupting the entire workflow. If the retried save fails again, it only marks that task as failed and tells you what to do next. Upon restarting after a crash, if a terminated agent is rejected for restart, its record row is directly marked as failed and allows the overall workflow to finish, rather than mistakenly displaying as running.

items.original:
A Workflow child that stops because its start record can't be saved, or because a different start record was already saved for it, now says in plain words that nothing new ran, that the other Workflow children keep running, and what to do next
A Workflow task that was interrupted right after it scheduled a retry now resumes with its recorded model and effort instead of being held
When a resumed Workflow task's first save fails before anything is written, only that task retries instead of the whole Workflow stopping; if the retry's save fails too, only that task fails and tells you what to do next
A Workflow resumed after a crash no longer shows a killed agent as still running when its relaunch is refused before it starts; the killed attempt's row now ends Failed and the Workflow completes

title.zh-TW: 工作流程恢復後保留自訂名稱，控制台與即時進度完整顯示
title.en: Workflows Retain Custom Names After Resuming, Displaying Fully in Console and Live Progress

body.zh-TW: 為工作流程取了清楚好記的專屬名稱，卻常在重新啟動或查閱紀錄時被打回預設代號。現在工作流程中途暫停並重新恢復後，各項流程訊息與結束提示都會完整保留先前記錄的自訂名稱。控制室面板以及點開的執行結果頁面，也會持續顯示該流程原本的名稱。新儲存的流程歷史紀錄與即時動態更新都會採用所記錄的名稱；如果遇上過去未儲存名稱的舊版執行紀錄，介面則會明確標記為「name unavailable」，方便你清楚辨識。⟦跟在專案檔案夾貼上手寫標籤一樣，中途交接給其他班次時，標籤依然牢牢貼在封面，不再因為換人接手就退回空白編號。⟧
body.en:
Giving a workflow a clear and memorable custom name often used to result in it reverting to a default identifier upon restarting or checking records. Now, after a workflow is paused mid-run and resumed, workflow messages and finish prompts fully retain the previously recorded custom name. The Mission Control panel and opened run result pages also consistently display the workflow's original name. Newly saved workflow history records and real-time live updates will use the recorded name. If encountering legacy execution records where names were not previously saved, the interface clearly marks them as "name unavailable" for easy identification.

⟦Much like a handwritten label taped to a project folder stays firmly on the cover during a handover to another shift, it no longer reverts to a blank number just because someone else took over.⟧

items.original:
Workflow messages and exit prompts keep the recorded name after resume
Workflow control rooms and opened results keep the recorded workflow name
Newly saved workflow history and live updates use recorded names, with "name unavailable" for older runs that have none

title.zh-TW: 子代理忠實遵從自訂思考力度，支援父任務等待時並行處理
title.en: Subagents Faithfully Honor Custom Reasoning Effort, Supporting Concurrent Processing While Parent Waits

body.zh-TW: 調派多個子代理分頭協同作業時，每位代理的推理深度與模型指派現在都能精準維持。透過工作階段協定啟動的工作階段，現在會遵循所儲存的思考力度（reasoning effort，決定模型在回答前投入多少深度推理的參數）。子代理會嚴格遵循其代理定義中設定的思考力度與專屬模型；當定義的模型無法使用時，會發出通知並改為備援使用當前工作階段的模型。若工作流程中的子代理指名了你工作階段的模型，即使該模型在重啟後被隱藏或自模型清單中移除，子代理依然會維持運行。在父代理處於等待狀態時，子代理現在獲准同步處理待處理的結果，不再平白枯等。⟦彷彿專案主管在等待外部回覆時，被分派任務的助理無須跟著停工，能繼續整理其他已送達的數據資料。⟧
body.en:
When dispatching multiple subagents to collaborate on tasks, the reasoning depth and model assignment of each agent can now be maintained precisely. Sessions launched via the session protocol now follow the saved reasoning effort (a parameter determining how much deep reasoning the model invests before answering). Subagents strictly adhere to the reasoning effort and dedicated model specified in their agent definitions. When a defined model is unavailable, a notification is sent, and it falls back to using the current session's model instead. If a subagent in a workflow specifies your session's model, it keeps running even if that model is hidden or removed from the model catalog after a restart. While the parent agent is in a waiting state, subagents are now permitted to process pending results concurrently instead of waiting idly.

⟦Imagine a project manager waiting for an external reply, where assigned assistants need not sit idle and can keep organizing other data that has already arrived.⟧

items.original:
Sessions started through the session protocol honor saved reasoning effort
Subagents now honor the reasoning effort set in their agent definition
A Workflow subagent that named your session's model keeps running after a restart even when that model is now hidden or missing from the model list, the same as one that left the model out
Subagents use their definition's model, falling back to the session model with a notice when unavailable
Allow subagents to process pending results while the parent waits

title.zh-TW: muse serve 載入對話不再卡死其他請求，健全歷史還原與帳號指引
title.en: muse serve No Longer Blocks Other Requests While Loading Chats, Solidifying History Restoration and Account Guidance

body.zh-TW: 將 Muse 當作本機背景伺服器運行時，多個工作階段並行存取的排程機制有了顯著改善。當你透過 `muse serve` 處理龐大對話時，伺服器在首次載入歷史紀錄、恢復或分支工作階段、開啟側邊對話、列出待審批項目或讀取工具輸出時，都能持續回應其他請求，不再拖住其他對話；嘗試恢復載入中的工作階段也會依序等待，而非誤報已被佔用。它現在能直接顯示 Muse 1.4.8 仍運行中的對話紀錄，即便儲存檢視檔案遭刪除也能正常還原。若啟動時缺乏模型清單且帳號需補填付款方式、新手導覽或年齡確認，對話輪次會明確說明該做什麼，不再無端要求重新登入。
body.en: When running Muse as a local background server, the scheduling mechanism for concurrent session access has improved significantly. When handling large conversations via `muse serve`, the server continues responding to other requests while initially loading history, resuming or branching sessions, opening side chats, listing pending approval items, or reading tool outputs, without stalling other conversations. Attempts to resume a session that is currently loading will now wait in turn rather than falsely reporting that it is already occupied. It can now directly display ongoing conversation records from Muse 1.4.8 and cleanly restore them even if saved view files were deleted. If the model list is missing at startup and the account requires adding a payment method, completing onboarding, or confirming age, the turn explicitly explains what needs to be done instead of prompting for a re-login without explanation.

items.original:
`muse serve` now shows the history of a session that Muse 1.4.8 is still running, instead of failing to read it until that session closes
When a `muse serve` client resumes a chat whose saved history view file was deleted, the chat shows its history again instead of none
`muse serve` keeps answering other requests while a long session's history loads for the first time, and resuming a session that is still loading waits for it instead of reporting the session as in use
`muse serve` keeps answering other requests while it resumes or forks a long session, opens a side chat on one, lists its pending approvals or reads one of its tool outputs, instead of stalling every other thread until that session's history is read
When `muse serve` starts with no saved model list and your account still needs a payment method, onboarding or age confirmation, turns now say what to do instead of asking you to log in again

title.zh-TW: 手動壓縮支援外接工具，修正檢查點儲存並加速大型工作階段分支
title.en: Manual Compaction Supports External Tools, Fixing Checkpoint Saves and Accelerating Large Session Branching

body.zh-TW: 對話內容過長而需要精簡上下文時，手動輸入 `/compact` 的觸發條件與儲存機制現在更為可靠。設定了外接工具 MCP（Model Context Protocol，讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）的工作階段，現在可以直接執行手動 `/compact`，不再回報無可壓縮內容。在儲存檢查點時若恰好遇到其他寫入操作，不會再遺漏儲存；重新開啟已儲存的對話後，壓縮也能持續正常運作，不再重複摘要並最終報錯。如果在送出模型請求前就取消訊息，執行壓縮會如實回報沒有內容可摘要，避免留下錯誤檢查點而導致後續跳過開發者指令。當工具結果被清除或提醒過期時，`/compact` 的 token（AI 處理與計費的文字單位）計算已獲修正；在經歷壓縮的超大型工作階段中，執行 `/btw`、`/side` 與 `/fork` 的開啟速度也明顯加快。
body.en: When conversations grow too long and context needs trimming, the trigger conditions and saving mechanisms for manually running `/compact` are now much more reliable. Sessions configured with external MCP (Model Context Protocol, a protocol enabling AI to connect to external tools) tools can now directly run manual `/compact` without reporting that there is nothing to compact. Saving a checkpoint while another write operation is occurring no longer drops the save. After reopening a saved conversation, compaction continues working normally rather than repeatedly summarizing and ultimately erroring out. If a message is canceled before sending the model request, running compaction accurately reports that there is no content to summarize, preventing invalid checkpoints that could cause subsequent developer instructions to be skipped. The token (a text unit for AI processing and billing) calculation for `/compact` has been corrected when tool results are cleared or reminders expire. In very large compacted sessions, opening speeds for running `/btw`, `/side`, and `/fork` are also noticeably faster.

items.original:
Manual `/compact` now compacts sessions with MCP servers configured, instead of answering "no compactable run is available"
A context compaction no longer skips its checkpoint when another session write lands while that checkpoint is being saved
Running /compact in a chat whose turns all ended before any model request (for example, a message cancelled before Muse began preparing its model request) now reports that there is nothing to summarize instead of writing a summary checkpoint that could later let the chat skip setting up its developer instructions
Compaction keeps working after you reopen a saved chat, instead of summarizing again at every boundary and eventually failing with "could not prepare the conversation"
Correct `/compact` token counts when tool results are cleared or reminders expire
`/btw`, `/side`, and `/fork` open faster in very large compacted sessions

title.zh-TW: 工作階段恢復嚴格檢驗啟動紀錄，掛鉤只在紀錄完整時觸發執行
title.en: Session Resumption Strictly Verifies Startup Logs, Firing Hooks Only When Logs Are Fully Intact

body.zh-TW: 重新開啟先前儲存的對話時，若背後的執行紀錄曾發生缺損，盲目載入往往會引發非預期的錯誤。如果工作階段的日誌無法證實其最後一次啟動紀錄，現在會直接拒絕恢復該對話，並在訊息中點名損毀的紀錄，不再默默開啟。在終端機介面恢復工作階段時，只有日誌能證實啟動完整的對話才會觸發 SessionStart 掛鉤（hook，特定事件發生時被觸發的小程式），其來源會標註為 `resume`。若對象是從未啟動的分支副本，來源則標註為 `fork`。若是無法證實啟動的副本，則完全不執行掛鉤並在啟動通知中說明。已儲存的工作階段格式也新增了標記欄位，可記錄儲存當下是否仍在啟動中；雖然目前尚未正式寫入，但未來一旦開始記錄，舊版 Muse 將拒絕開啟這類工作階段以防出錯。
body.en: When reopening a previously saved conversation, blindly loading it often causes unexpected errors if the underlying execution logs were corrupted. If a session log cannot verify its last startup record, it now explicitly refuses to resume that conversation and names the corrupted record in the message, rather than opening silently. When resuming a session in the terminal interface, only conversations whose startup can be verified by the log will trigger the SessionStart hook (a small program triggered by a specific event), with its source marked as `resume`. For branched copies that have never been started, the source is marked as `fork`. For copies whose startup cannot be verified, the hook is not executed at all, and an explanation is provided in the startup notification. The saved session format also adds a flag field to record whether it was still starting up at the time of saving. Although not actively written yet, once recorded in the future, legacy versions of Muse will refuse to open such sessions to prevent errors.

items.original:
Saved sessions can record whether a run was still starting when they were saved; nothing records it yet, so no session opens differently today, and once a later Muse records it, Muse versions released before that one will not open such a session
Resuming a session whose log cannot prove its last start is refused with a message naming the broken record instead of opening silently
SessionStart hooks run on every resumed TUI session whose log proves its last start, reporting `resume` (or `fork` for a never-activated clone) as their source; a replayed copy that cannot prove it runs none and says so in its startup notice

title.zh-TW: 跨桌面與終端切換即時同步對話，分支重試具備冪等性不再撞號
title.en: Real-time conversation sync across desktop and terminal switches, with idempotent branch retries that prevent collisions

body.zh-TW: 在桌面應用程式與終端機之間切換工作環境時，不同版本之間的對話紀錄接軌現在省去了不必要的等待。若桌面端與終端機運行的 Muse Code 版本不同，切換時會直接同步另一端剛進行的簡短對話，不再從頭重新建構歷史紀錄（自 1.4.9 以前版本升級後的首次開啟仍會重建一次）。恢復進度落後的對話時，會在同一次恢復中直接補齊最新紀錄，不再出現歷史空白或遺漏即時回覆。使用相同指令識別碼重試分支時，會符合冪等（idempotent，多次執行結果與單次相同）原則直接回傳原始結果，不再報錯；指定不同切分時則維持衝突。即使對話含有中途送達的背景任務通知，分支在應用程式與 SDK 也能順利載入。工作階段中模型重複使用工具識別碼不再破壞後續壓縮，載入重複核准紀錄的工作階段時記憶體消耗也明顯降低。
body.en: When switching work environments between the desktop application and the terminal, bridging conversation history across different versions now eliminates unnecessary waiting. If the desktop app and terminal run different versions of Muse Code, switching will directly sync recent short conversations from the other side rather than rebuilding history from scratch (the first launch after upgrading from versions prior to 1.4.9 still rebuilds once). When restoring a conversation that has fallen behind, the latest records are backfilled in the same restoration pass, preventing history gaps or missing real-time replies. When retrying a branch using the same command identifier, it adheres to idempotent principles (yielding identical results when run multiple times as when run once) and directly returns the original result instead of throwing an error. Specifying a different split continues to raise a conflict. Even if a conversation contains background task notifications delivered midway, branches load smoothly across both the application and the SDK. A model reusing tool identifiers within a session no longer breaks subsequent compaction, and memory consumption drops significantly when loading sessions with duplicate approval records.

items.original:
A forked chat whose history has a background-task notice delivered mid-turn now opens in apps and SDKs in more cases, instead of failing to load
Switching a conversation between the desktop app and the terminal when they run different versions of Muse Code now catches up a short exchange made on the other side instead of rebuilding its saved history from scratch; the first open after updating from a release before 1.4.9 still rebuilds it once
Resuming a thread whose saved history had fallen far behind now brings it up to date in that same resume, instead of showing no history and missing live replies until the next resume
A session whose model reused a tool call id for two same-length results no longer becomes impossible to resume or compact after old tool results are cleared
Retrying a fork with the same command id now returns the original outcome instead of answering command_id_conflict, matching gate-off idempotency; reusing a command id with a different cut still conflicts
Reduce memory use when loading sessions with repeated approval records

title.zh-TW: 長篇分析回答改用短句分段，隱藏無回應標記並自動補問
title.en: Long analytical responses switch to short-sentence paragraphs, hiding no-reply markers with automatic follow-up questions

body.zh-TW: 閱讀 AI 產生的長篇分析報告時，密密麻麻的一整片文字往往讓人難以快速抓住重點。現在遇到長篇分析類型的回答，模型會主動採用短句與精簡段落進行排版，取代過去整面難以閱讀的文字牆。若先前對話中途意外中斷，使得某一輪的最終結果只剩下一行「前一輪未產生助手回覆」的內部標記，Muse 會自動發起一次有限度的重新提問，為你取得真正的實質回覆，並在執行摘要中主動剔除該標記。對話紀錄面板也不再顯示帶有菱形符號的「◆ [Previous turn ended without an assistant reply.]」提示列；如果回答只包含該標記，畫面不會渲染任何內容，若標記後方附有正常回答，則只乾淨呈現正式的回答內容。⟦恰似專業編輯重新編排文稿，不僅將密集論述切成清晰段落，也在印製時主動抽除排版留下的空白除錯標記。⟧
body.en: When reading long analytical reports generated by AI, dense walls of text often make it hard to quickly grasp key points. When encountering long analytical responses, the model now proactively formats output using short sentences and concise paragraphs, replacing the previously unreadable walls of text. If a previous conversation was interrupted unexpectedly so that a turn's final output was left with only an internal marker indicating that the prior turn produced no assistant reply, Muse automatically issues a bounded re-prompt to retrieve a genuine response, actively stripping that marker from the run summaries. The conversation history panel also no longer displays the prompt bar `◆ [Previous turn ended without an assistant reply.]` with its diamond symbol. If a response contains only that marker, the screen renders nothing, and if normal answers follow the marker, it cleanly presents only the formal response content. ⟦A professional editor reformats a manuscript by breaking dense arguments into clear paragraphs and stripping out leftover blank debugging marks before printing.⟧

items.original:
Long analysis answers use short sentences and paragraphs instead of dense walls of text
A turn whose final answer consists only of the "[Previous turn ended without an assistant reply.]" marker now gets one bounded re-prompt for a real reply, and the marker is stripped from run summaries
The transcript no longer shows a "◆ [Previous turn ended without an assistant reply.]" row — a reply containing only that resume marker renders nothing, and a real answer prefixed by it shows just the answer

title.zh-TW: 開發者指令阻擋改以白話引導，SDK 撤回狀態與技能範例修復
title.en: Developer command blocks switch to plain-language guidance, and SDK retraction states and skill examples receive fixes

body.zh-TW: 串接工具時，晦澀報錯常令人卡關。EdenFS 查全庫 Sapling（`hg files`、`hg locate`、`hg manifest`）卡死前阻擋，改指引 `search` 或 `hg biggrep`。衍生子行程遭拒改以白話說明，不再顯示內部列舉代碼。連接外部工具的 MCP 伺服器啟動存活未回，改報 `the server did not respond during startup` 而非泛用逾時。TypeScript 與 Python SDK 撤回遭拒不再誤標撤回或丟棄；前者的 `StaleDroppableMethod` 納入 `turn/retracted`，窮舉比對需補分支。內建 Three.js 技能改用可運作的 WebGPU 後製，不再引用已移除舊檔。
body.en: When integrating tools, cryptic error messages often cause roadblocks. Sapling repository-wide queries on EdenFS (`hg files`, `hg locate`, `hg manifest`) are blocked before hanging, redirecting users to `search` or `hg biggrep`. Spawned subprocess rejections are now explained in plain language instead of displaying internal enum codes. When an MCP (a protocol connecting AI to external tools) server fails to respond during startup liveness checks, it now reports `the server did not respond during startup` instead of a generic timeout. Retraction rejections in the TypeScript and Python SDKs are no longer mistakenly marked as retracted or dropped. The former's `StaleDroppableMethod` now incorporates `turn/retracted`, requiring an additional branch for exhaustive matching. The built-in Three.js skill now switches to working WebGPU post-processing instead of referencing removed legacy files.

items.original:
Spawn rejection hints now explain the reason in plain words instead of internal enum names
Repository-wide Sapling file listings (`hg files`, `hg locate`, `hg manifest`) on EdenFS checkouts are refused before they hang, pointing at `search` or `hg biggrep` instead
An MCP server whose process stays alive but never responds during startup now fails with `the server did not respond during startup` instead of the generic operation timeout
The TypeScript and Python SDKs no longer mark a turn retracted, or drop its completion, when its retract is declined; in the TypeScript SDK, `StaleDroppableMethod` gains `turn/retracted`, so code that matches it exhaustively needs a new case
The bundled Three.js skill now gives a working WebGPU post-processing example instead of one that imports a file current three.js no longer ships

title.zh-TW: Windows 版恢復 hook 安裝與更新
title.en: Windows Restores Hook Installation and Updates

body.zh-TW: 若你在 Windows 電腦上使用時，曾碰過切換設定後毫無動靜，現在各項開關都能正常生效了。⟦就像按下電燈開關，以前怎麼按都沒有反應，現在一按燈就亮了。⟧這項問題源自工具仰賴 hook（掛鉤，特定事件發生時被觸發的小程式）來串接各項功能。從 v0.33.2 版起，Windows 打包時未將 hook 腳本放入安裝程式讀取的資料夾，導致安裝程式找不到檔案。連帶讓首次設定，以及接續對話、精簡模式與額度感知等開關在點擊後靜默沒有反應，原本已裝好的 hook 也停止更新。macOS 系統完全不受此問題影響。現在 Windows 版已恢復正常，能順利安裝並持續更新 hook。
body.en: If you previously experienced toggling settings on Windows with no response, all switches now take effect normally. ⟦Think of flipping a light switch: pressing it previously produced no reaction at all, but now the light turns on immediately.⟧ This issue stemmed from the tool relying on hooks (scripts triggered when specific events occur) to connect various features. Starting from v0.33.2, Windows packaging failed to include hook scripts in the folder read by the installer, leaving the installer unable to find the files. Consequently, initial setup as well as switches for continuing conversations, compact mode, and quota awareness silently failed to respond when clicked, and previously installed hooks also stopped updating. macOS is completely unaffected by this issue. Windows has now returned to normal, smoothly installing and continuously updating hooks.

items.original: **Windows installs hooks and keeps them up to date again.** Since v0.33.2 the Windows build left the hook scripts out of the folder the installer reads, so first-run setup and the resume, terse and quota-aware toggles silently did nothing, and existing hooks stopped updating. macOS was not affected.

title.zh-TW: Antigravity 卡片支援切換至 Argon 額度
title.en: Antigravity Card Supports Switching to Argon Quota

body.zh-TW: 用 Antigravity 的 Gemini 4 Argon 時，現在也能在卡片上看到它的額度。卡片上的群組切換按鈕現在會依序輪播，在 Gemini、Claude 與 GPT 之外，多了一組 Gemini 4 Argon 可以選。⟦正如冷氣遙控器上的模式切換鍵，以前只能在冷氣和除濕之間跳轉，現在多按一下就能切到全新的節能風速，隨時掌握每週能吹多久。⟧由於 Argon 只有每週總額度，原本顯示五小時用量的那一列會直接清楚說明，不會讓你猜測數字為何空白。至於 Claude Code 側邊面板與 Antigravity 的 status line（顯示在終端機最底下的狀態列）則維持精簡，不會顯示 Argon 的資訊。
body.en: If you use Gemini 4 Argon in Antigravity, the card can now show its quota too. The group toggle button on the card now cycles sequentially, adding a Gemini 4 Argon option alongside Gemini, Claude, and GPT. ⟦Think of the mode button on an air conditioner remote: where you previously could only toggle between cooling and dehumidifying, one extra press now switches to a brand-new eco fan speed to track how long you can run it each week.⟧ Because Argon only provides a weekly total quota, the row that previously displayed five-hour usage now explains this clearly rather than leaving you guessing why the number is blank. Meanwhile, the Claude Code side panel and the Antigravity status line (the status bar displayed at the bottom of the terminal) remain streamlined, omitting Argon information.

items.original: **The Antigravity card can switch to the Gemini 4 Argon quota.** The group toggle now cycles Gemini → Claude / GPT → Argon. Argon has a weekly limit only, so its 5-hour row says so. The Claude Code side pane and the Antigravity status line leave Argon out.

title.zh-TW: 用量報表改用淡色底填滿佔比，版面更易閱讀
title.en: Usage Reports Use Soft Background Fills for Proportions to Improve Readability

body.zh-TW: 每次打開用量報表想比較各工具的花費時，現在一眼就看得出誰佔得多。原本貼在每列最底部的細條，視覺上往往容易讓人誤以為是排版畫歪的文字底線；現在每一列會依照實際的使用佔比，順著整列填滿該工具專屬的柔和淡色底色。⟦跟用螢光筆畫重點一樣，以前像拿細原子筆在字底下劃出歪斜線段，現在直接順著長度刷上一層淡色標記，一眼就能看清誰佔了最多篇幅。⟧不同工具的列與列之間，也改用乾淨舒適的間距留白，直接取代原本生硬的分隔線，讓整張統計報表變得清爽易讀。
body.en: Whenever you open usage reports to compare spending across tools, you can now see at a glance which one takes the largest share. The thin bar originally tucked at the bottom of each row was often visually mistaken for a misaligned text underline; now, each row fills across with its tool-specific soft pastel background based on actual usage share. ⟦Picture using a marker to highlight key points: instead of scratching crooked lines under text with a fine ballpoint pen, a gentle wash of color now brushes along the entire row so you can spot who takes up the most space at a glance.⟧ Clean, comfortable spacing between rows of different tools directly replaces the rigid dividers, leaving the entire statistics report crisp and readable.

items.original: **Report rows show their share as a faint tint across the row.** The thin bars along each row's bottom edge read as crooked underlines; rows now fill with the tool's color up to their share, with spacing instead of separator lines.

title.zh-TW: Antigravity 額度顯示修復，不再漏看週額度或誤判耗盡
title.en: Antigravity Quota Display Fixed to Prevent Missing Weekly Quotas or False Exhaustion

body.zh-TW:
使用 Antigravity 時，你可能遇過額度資訊消失、甚至讓助理誤判停工的窘境。⟦彷彿盤點庫存，以前清單漏列一筆就以為全部缺貨，現在會翻開帳冊查證，並把各貨架剩餘品項交代清楚。⟧

Gemini 週額度重新回歸。由於 Google 的額度 API（提供用量數據的介面）不再回報該數字，usage 改直接向 Antigravity CLI 執行 `agy -p /usage` 查詢且不呼叫模型，無法執行時才退回原 API。

發給 Claude 的額度提醒也不再引發誤會。過去某組額度耗盡，容易讓 Claude 誤以為 Antigravity 徹底停用；現在提示每行都會寫明受限的工具與模型組別，並緊接著列出仍有剩餘額度的組別，末端還會附上 Claude Code 自身用量。
body.en:
When using Antigravity, you may have encountered quota information vanishing or even causing an assistant to mistakenly halt work. ⟦Much like taking inventory where a single line missing from a list made you assume everything was out of stock, staff now open the ledger to verify records and clearly account for items left on each shelf.⟧

Gemini weekly quotas make a return. Because Google's quota API (the interface providing usage metrics) no longer reports this figure, usage now queries the Antigravity CLI directly with `agy -p /usage` without invoking models, only falling back to the original API if execution fails.

Quota reminders sent to Claude no longer cause misunderstandings. In the past, exhausting a single quota easily led Claude to assume Antigravity was entirely out of commission; now, every reminder line specifies the constrained tool and model group, immediately followed by groups that still have remaining quota, with Claude Code's own usage appended at the end.

items.original:
**Antigravity shows its Gemini weekly quota again.** Google's quota API stopped reporting it, so usage now asks the Antigravity CLI itself (`agy -p /usage`, which makes no model call) and falls back to the API when the CLI is unavailable.
**The quota reminder no longer makes Claude think Antigravity is used up.** Each line names the tool and models it limits, a spent Antigravity group is followed by the groups that still have quota, and the reminder ends with Claude Code's own usage.

title.zh-TW: 用量報表前後矛盾修復，計費與標籤口徑一致
title.en: Usage Report Inconsistencies Fixed to Align Cost and Label Definitions

body.zh-TW:
翻閱長期的統計數據時，你可能曾被突然飆高的百分比或不明金額嚇了一跳。⟦如同重新校對後的家庭記帳本，以前看到莫名暴增的支出總讓人困惑，現在每一筆開銷都標明計算方式與比較週期，帳目清清楚楚。⟧

換算金額在全頁統一稱為「API 等值」，不再有混淆稱呼。過去 Grok 模型一律算成零元，現在會正確對上 xAI 官方價格並算回等值金額，Wrapped 統計也會特別註明哪些日期具備價格紀錄。

報表計算邏輯也補齊了各項說明。週總結現在會清楚寫明比較的是哪兩個完整週，不足七天起步的首週不再算出暴增 980% 這類離奇數字；切到「全部」時間範圍時，會備註更早之前僅有每日總量。各模組標示也一併釐清，派工帳本欄位寫明為週額度佔比，各項排行也明訂依 token（AI 處理與計費的文字單位）排序。
body.en:
Browsing long-term statistics, you might have been startled by suddenly spiking percentages or unexplained amounts. ⟦Like a reconciled household ledger where an unexplained surge in expenses once caused confusion, every outgoing cost now notes its calculation method and comparison timeframe, keeping the accounts completely transparent.⟧

Converted amounts are consistently labeled throughout the page as “API equivalent” to eliminate confusing naming. Past Grok models were always calculated as zero dollars, but they now properly match official xAI pricing to calculate equivalent amounts, and Wrapped statistics specifically note which dates have pricing records.

Report calculation logic now includes comprehensive explanations. Weekly summaries state clearly which two complete weeks are being compared, preventing partial initial weeks of fewer than seven days from producing bizarre figures like a 980% surge. Switching to the “All” timeframe adds a note that earlier periods only record daily totals. Module labels have also been clarified, specifying the task ledger column as a percentage of weekly quota and explicitly sorting rankings by tokens (text units used for AI processing and billing).

items.original:
**Grok usage has an API-equivalent value again.** Grok models now match their xAI price entries instead of counting as $0.
**The usage report no longer contradicts itself.** The weekly summary names the completed weeks it compares, a partial first week no longer produces changes like +980%, the converted amount is called "API equivalent" everywhere, Wrapped notes which days have saved prices, the "All" range explains that earlier days only have daily totals, the dispatch ledger labels its columns as weekly quota shares, and rankings say they are by tokens.

title.zh-TW: Antigravity 恢復顯示 Gemini 額度，週額度用盡改標暫停
title.en: Antigravity Restores Gemini Quota Display and Labels It Paused When Weekly Quota Runs Out

body.zh-TW: 當你打開終端機準備趕工，卻擔心用量超標時，現在不必再對著空白面板瞎猜了。⟦好比運動中心的計時卡，以前週額度用完時，當天的五小時欄位還顯示全滿；現在不僅能從清單找回剩餘額度，總量用盡時也會改標為暫停。⟧先前 Google 的額度摘要不再回傳 Gemini 群組，讓 Antigravity 一度看不到用量。現在 usage 改從模型清單直接讀取 Gemini 的 5 小時額度。由於 Google 目前未回報週額度，卡片上會清楚標明未回報。只要應用程式開著，Antigravity CLI 的 status line（顯示在終端機最底下的狀態列）也會同步顯示這組數字。一旦週額度用盡，Google 會在此時暫停 5 小時限額。過去該列會顯示「0% 已用／額度全滿」，容易讓人誤以為還能用；現在 5 小時那一列會直接改標為「暫停」，避免誤判。
body.en: When you open your terminal to work under a deadline and worry about exceeding usage, you no longer have to guess against a blank panel. ⟦Think of a sports center pass: in the past, when the weekly quota ran out, the day's five-hour slot still showed completely full; now it not only retrieves the remaining quota from the list, but also marks it as paused once the total is exhausted.⟧ Previously, Google's quota summary stopped returning the Gemini group, leaving Antigravity temporarily unable to see usage. Now usage reads Gemini's 5-hour quota directly from the model list instead. Because Google does not currently report weekly quota, the card clearly marks it as unreported. As long as the application is running, the Antigravity CLI status line (the status bar displayed at the very bottom of the terminal) also displays these numbers in sync. Once the weekly quota is exhausted, Google pauses the 5-hour limit at that point. In the past, that row displayed "0% used / full quota", easily misleading users into thinking it was still usable; now the 5-hour row is directly labeled "Paused" to avoid misjudgment.

items.original:
**Antigravity shows your Gemini quota again.** Google's quota summary no longer returns the Gemini group. usage now reads Gemini's five-hour quota from the model list. Google does not currently report its weekly quota; the card labels it as not reported. While the app is running, the Antigravity CLI status line uses these numbers too.
**The Antigravity 5-hour row says "Paused" once the weekly quota is used up.** Google pauses the 5-hour limit at that point, and the row used to read "0% used / Quota full", which looked usable.

title.zh-TW: 修復四處安全漏洞，防範非預期檔案寫入與驗證被繞過
title.en: Fix Four Security Vulnerabilities to Prevent Unexpected File Writes and Verification Bypasses

body.zh-TW: 下載、安裝技能或驗證產物時不再受惡意名稱所害，建議盡快升到 `v2.102.0`。`gh release download`、`gh run download`、`gh repo read-file --output` 與 `gh attestation download` 遇目的地含符號連結（指向其他位置的捷徑檔）時，以前可能寫入非預期的本機檔案。`gh attestation verify` 以前比對 `--source-ref` 不分大小寫，且 `--signer-workflow` 只比憑證身分開頭，僅大小寫不同的分支，或同儲存庫內路徑開頭相同的另一個工作流程，都可能通過驗證。互動式 `gh skill search` 傳路徑給 `gh skill install` 時缺少選項分隔符號，搜尋結果可能注入安裝選項並改寫檔案位置。⟦就像同一棟樓四扇門的鎖被一次補好。⟧
body.en: Downloading artifacts, installing skills, or verifying attestations is no longer vulnerable to malicious names, and upgrading to `v2.102.0` as soon as possible is recommended. When the destination contains a symlink, `gh release download`, `gh run download`, `gh repo read-file --output`, and `gh attestation download` previously risked writing to unintended local files. `gh attestation verify` previously compared `--source-ref` case-insensitively and only matched the prefix of certificate identities for `--signer-workflow`, allowing branches differing only by case or another workflow with a matching path prefix in the same repository to pass verification. Interactive `gh skill search` lacked an option delimiter when passing paths to `gh skill install`, which allowed search results to inject installation options and alter file locations. ⟦Picture locks on four doors of the same building being fixed all at once.⟧

items.original:
## Security

Four security vulnerabilities have been identified, and fixed, in this release. Users are advised to update gh to version `v2.102.0` as soon as possible.

`gh release download`, `gh run download`, `gh repo read-file --output`, and `gh attestation download` could write remote content to an unintended local file when the destination contained symbolic links.

See https://github.com/cli/cli/security/advisories/GHSA-39wj-f2f4-978v for more information.

`gh attestation verify` compared the `--source-ref` value case-insensitively, so an attestation built from a branch whose name differs only in case could satisfy a policy that named a different branch.

See https://github.com/cli/cli/security/advisories/GHSA-4mq3-hpgx-9cx8 for more information.

Interactive `gh skill search` passed repository paths from search results to `gh skill install` without an option separator, so a search result could inject installer options and change where skill files were written.

See https://github.com/cli/cli/security/advisories/GHSA-qcwj-mr2r-2cx7 for more information.

`gh attestation verify` matched the `--signer-workflow` value against only the start of the signing certificate's identity, so an attestation signed by a different workflow in the pinned repository could pass verification when its path began with the pinned value.

See https://github.com/cli/cli/security/advisories/GHSA-wjmr-j3rp-mh2g for more information.

title.zh-TW: Linux 上用 APT 或 RPM 裝的 gh 要認新金鑰
title.en: gh installed via APT or RPM on Linux needs the new signing key

body.zh-TW: 你在 Linux 上更新 `gh`，卻突然裝不起來、報簽章驗證失敗？多半是金鑰換了。GitHub CLI 的 APT 與 RPM 套件庫（Linux 下載與更新軟體的官方來源），連同個別的 RPM 套件檔，現在只用新的 PGP 金鑰簽署，指紋是 `7F38BBB59D064DBCB3D84D725612B36462313325`。如果你在 2026 年 4 月 8 日前從官方 APT 或 RPM 套件庫裝了 `gh`，又還沒更新金鑰圈（電腦裡記著哪些簽章可以信任的清單），安裝或更新就可能失敗。⟦就像快遞改用新封條，你家警衛只認得舊封條，包裹就會被擋在門外，得先把新封條的樣子告訴警衛。⟧照官方的 PGP 簽章金鑰輪換說明檢查、更新金鑰圈就能解決。用 Windows、macOS，或透過 Homebrew、GitHub Releases、其他套件管理器、原始碼安裝的人不受影響。
body.en: Updating `gh` on Linux and suddenly getting a signature verification failure? The signing key most likely changed. GitHub CLI's APT and RPM repositories, along with individual RPM packages, are now signed only with the new PGP key, fingerprint `7F38BBB59D064DBCB3D84D725612B36462313325`. ## Linux package repository signing key rotation

GitHub CLI's APT and RPM repositories, along with individual RPM packages, are now signed only with the new PGP key (fingerprint: `7F38BBB59D064DBCB3D84D725612B36462313325`)

> [!IMPORTANT]
> Linux users who installed `gh` from the official APT or RPM repositories before April 8, 2026, and have not refreshed their keyring, may now see package installation or update failures. Follow the [PGP signing key rotation guidance](https://github.com/cli/cli/issues/13118) to check and update your keyring. Users on Windows or macOS, and users who installed `gh` through Homebrew, GitHub Releases, another package manager, or from source, are not affected.

title.zh-TW: gh 登入時自動幫你複製驗證碼
title.en: gh now copies your login code for you

body.zh-TW:
用 `gh auth login` 登入 GitHub，或用 `gh auth refresh` 更新權限時，畫面會給你一組 OAuth 裝置代碼（要貼到瀏覽器授權頁、證明是你本人在登入的短碼）。以前你得自己反白、複製，再切到瀏覽器貼上；現在這兩個指令預設會直接把代碼放進剪貼簿，切過去按貼上就好。⟦櫃檯人員直接把號碼牌塞到你手上，你就不必再拿筆抄一次號碼。⟧不想要這個行為，可以用下面這行永久關掉：

```shell
gh config set clipboard disabled
```

某一次執行時如果你另外指定了剪貼簿選項，那一次就照你指定的來。
body.en:
When you sign in with `gh auth login` or refresh permissions with `gh auth refresh`, the screen gives you an OAuth device code to paste into the browser's authorization page. You used to highlight it, copy it, then switch to the browser and paste. Now both commands put the code on your clipboard by default, so you just switch over and paste. ⟦Think of a service desk where the clerk hands you the ticket instead of making you copy the number down with a pen.⟧ To turn this off for good, run:

```shell
gh config set clipboard disabled
```

If you pass an explicit clipboard option on a single run, that run follows your choice.

items.original:
## Copy authentication codes to the clipboard by default

`gh auth login` and `gh auth refresh` now copy OAuth device codes to the clipboard by default, saving a manual copy step during authentication.

To persistently opt out, run:

```shell
gh config set clipboard disabled
```

Explicit clipboard options still take precedence for an individual invocation.

title.zh-TW: GitHub API 流量支援自訂閘道，身分驗證與網址維持直連
title.en: GitHub API Traffic Supports Custom Gateways, While Authentication and URLs Remain Direct

body.zh-TW:
企業若需要稽核或集中管控網路流量，現在可以透過個別主機的 `api_host` 設定，將 GitHub API 請求導向自訂閘道（gateway，把流量轉去另一個位址再送出的中繼點）。這項改動只會轉發 API 呼叫，登入身分驗證、Git 遠端儲存庫操作與瀏覽器開啟網址仍會直接連線至原始主機。此功能目前仍處於實驗階段，且不是安全邊界，部分請求可能依然會送往原始主機。

```
# 設定將 github.com 的 API 流量轉發至自訂閘道
gh config set api_host gh-gateway.example.com --host github.com

# 查詢特定主機目前設定的 API 閘道位址
gh config get api_host --host github.com
```

⟦這就像公司設立的公務收發室，員工採購與查詢資料等業務公文統一由專屬窗口轉交處理，但員工出勤打卡、私人包裹寄送與親自拜訪仍直接走大樓正門。⟧
body.en:
Organizations that need to audit or centrally manage network traffic can now route GitHub API requests to a custom gateway via the per-host `api_host` setting. This change only forwards API calls; login authentication, Git remote repository operations, and browser-opened URLs still connect directly to the original host. This feature is currently experimental and is not a security boundary, so some requests may still reach the original host.

```
# Set up forwarding API traffic for github.com to a custom gateway
gh config set api_host gh-gateway.example.com --host github.com

# Query the currently configured API gateway address for a specific host
gh config get api_host --host github.com
```

⟦This is like a company mailroom for official business, where business documents such as procurement requests and data inquiries are routed through a dedicated counter, while employee clock-ins, personal parcel deliveries, and in-person visits still go directly through the building's main entrance.⟧

items.original:
## Experimental: Route GitHub API traffic through a custom host

Organizations can now route a GitHub host's API traffic through a gateway using the new per-host `api_host` configuration:

```shell
# Route API traffic for github.com through a gateway
gh config set api_host gh-gateway.example.com --host github.com

# Read the configured API host
gh config get api_host --host github.com
```

The original host remains in use for authentication, Git remotes, and browser URLs.

> [!NOTE]
> `api_host` is experimental and is not a security boundary. Requests may still reach the original host.
